programme.title: 我要逆風去
programme.desc: 我要逆風去是一部都市情感與勵志職場劇，講述民族服飾品牌在電商經濟衝擊下復興的歷程自香港投行跳槽回內地投資公司發展的投資人徐斯（龔俊飾），結識了國牌服裝集團董事長獨生女江湖（鍾楚曦飾），二人因商業理念不同而互不對盤江湖父親的企業突然破產，江湖一夜之間由雲端跌落谷底而一直頗有事業野心的徐斯對江湖父親曾經一手打造的膠底鞋品牌騰嶽勢在必得，使得落魄的江湖決定不惜一切保住騰嶽經一番周旋較量，最終徐斯與江湖立下是否能夠復興騰嶽的存亡生死契

programme.title: 葡萄牙燈塔 第一季
programme.desc: 葡萄牙燈塔 第一季是一部由葡萄牙電視台精心製作的資訊紀錄片影集該節目走訪葡萄牙沿岸及島嶼，帶領觀眾深入探索守護海岸線的宏偉燈塔，以及那些在孤獨與風暴中堅守崗位的燈塔守護人的真實生活與歷史故事

澳門人澳門事
programme.desc: 活在澳門, 感受生活,ampampampampampltbrampampampampampgtampampampampamplt澳門人．澳門事ampampampampampgt,ampampampampampltbrampampampampampgt探索城市每個角落關注民生議題繁華背後發掘一個又一個澳門人的故事欣賞各地藝術風采推廣本土文化藝術重溫舊城舊事，翻開當中的歷史記憶走過不同地方，感受人民風情緊貼你的生活資訊節目

programme.title: 澳門老店傳承
programme.desc: 為慶祝澳門回歸25周年，本次將製作澳門老店傳承節目，以在澳門經營最少25年的店舖或老店，一同見證澳門一起成長的故事ampampampampampltbrampampampampampgtampampampampampltbrampampampampampgt我們會走訪不同區份的老店，一起細味熟悉的味道，當中還包括店鋪的經營方式承傳故事及周邊民生的情形，重溫幾代人見證澳門發展的點滴，並且分享回歸後到現在的改變訴說眼中的澳門，心中的家國情懷

programme.title: 好劇連場: 一起深呼吸
programme.desc: 一起深呼吸由戚薇楊祐寧主演，以中國醫生到海外援助其他國家為背景，當中不乏逼真的醫療手術畫面故事講述一支中國援外醫療隊剛剛抵達劄爾島，便遇上了突發地震，眾人立即展開救援華裔醫生李天成登島參加前女友凱莉和好兄弟喬向晚的訂婚宴，出於職業本能，果斷加入醫療隊，投入到了搶救工作中醫療隊的婦產科醫生周悅有著豐富援外經驗的李天成和理性冷靜的外科醫生廖宇等人，在嚴峻的援助形勢和巨大的文化差異下，衝破重重阻礙，開展了醫療救援和醫學科普等行動在援劄期間，援外醫生們用精湛的醫術和過人的勇氣，與當地富紳展開了驚心動魄的較量，找到了疫苗失活的真相，並成功阻止了一場可怖瘟疫的爆發，在救死扶傷的同時贏得了當地島民的尊重經歷了心理和情感的風雨歷練，周悅和李天成在醫治患者的同時也療愈了自己內心的傷痛，真正體悟了希波克拉底誓言的深層含義，更加堅定了拯救患者生命的決心，兩人亦攜手，在而後的援助醫療道路上結伴同行

今日宜加油
programme.desc: 今日宜加油是一部職場題材電視劇，根據韓國漫畫高斯電子公司改編，由鄭愷陳鈺琪王鶴棣主演，故事講述高發電子公司中企劃三部曾是高發電子最風光的部門，近三年因不靠譜企劃地位一落千丈但部門眾人以各自方式演繹平凡奮鬥者的生活，李天然範思思吳意美白馬帥等，有夢想有執著，對部門有深厚感情他們面臨副董挑刺一部競爭，用努力化解危機，使三部重回巔峰，也在笑中帶淚的職場中成長，收穫愛情與友情

趨記茶餐廳
programme.desc: 一部以澳門茶餐廳為背景的輕鬆幽默連續劇，故事圍繞茶餐廳的日常營運展開，當中穿插生活熱話，搞笑得來又有共鳴，歡迎大家光臨！

programme.title: 我要逆風去
programme.desc: 我要逆風去是一部都市情感與勵志職場劇，講述民族服飾品牌在電商經濟衝擊下復興的歷程自香港投行跳槽回內地投資公司發展的投資人徐斯（龔俊飾），結識了國牌服裝集團董事長獨生女江湖（鍾楚曦飾），二人因商業理念不同而互不對盤江湖父親的企業突然破產，江湖一夜之間由雲端跌落谷底而一直頗有事業野心的徐斯對江湖父親曾經一手打造的膠底鞋品牌騰嶽勢在必得，使得落魄的江湖決定不惜一切保住騰嶽經一番周旋較量，最終徐斯與江湖立下是否能夠復興騰嶽的存亡生死契

programme.title: 林則徐 虎門銷煙以外
programme.desc: 2025年，適逢民族英雄林則徐誕辰二百四十周年國家主席習近平在福州任職期間，保育了林則徐出生地的一系列遺跡他先後多次引用林則徐苟利國家生死以，豈因禍福避趨之的名句，號召國人把林則徐的民族精神和優秀品格繼承發揚下去ampampampampltbrampampampampgt林則徐：虎門銷煙以外是一部由香港電台出品的五集歷史人文紀錄片影片以香港視角出發，跨越三萬公里深入中國多省市（包括澳門廣東湖南福建浙江河南陝西甘肅新疆），更東渡日本，探尋虎門銷煙之外那個更為真實立體的林則徐ampampampampltbrampampampampgt林則徐虎門銷煙的壯舉固然永載史冊，但其光輝遠不止於此本紀錄片突破傳統敘事框架，不僅回顧林則徐虎門銷煙的功績，更深入挖掘他作為治水能臣嚴謹學者流放者與思想家的多面人生透過實地探訪專家訪談，並結合AI技術生成動畫重現歷史場景，影片呈現林則徐在禁煙海防水利邊疆開發等方面的卓越貢獻，並揭示其開眼看世界的深遠影響節目以細膩的鏡頭語言和情感敘述，串聯歷史與當下，展現林則徐精神的當代意義，值此民族英雄誕辰二百四十周年之際，向他獻上最誠摯的敬意本片由ampampampamplt香港電台ampampampampgt贈播

programme.title: 澳門人澳門事
programme.desc: 活在澳門, 感受生活,ampampampampltbrampampampampgtampampampamplt澳門人．澳門事ampampampampgt,ampampampampltbrampampampampgt探索城市每個角落關注民生議題繁華背後發掘一個又一個澳門人的故事欣賞各地藝術風采推廣本土文化藝術重溫舊城舊事，翻開當中的歷史記憶走過不同地方，感受人民風情緊貼你的生活資訊節目

부모의 첫 성교육
programme.desc: 전문가와 함께 쉽고 유쾌하게 배우는 부모 맞춤 성교육 안내서!

programme.title: 최고의 요리비결
programme.desc: 당신도 요리의 달인이 될 수 있다. 최고의 요리비결은 국내 최고의 요리전문가에게서 최고의 요리 비결만을 전수받을 수 있는 정통 요리 프로그램!

programme.title: 세계테마기행
programme.desc: 세계테마기행은 단순한 여행 정보 프로그램에서 벗어나, 자유로운 배낭여행자만이 느낄 수 있는 살아있는 체험기를 전해드리고자 기획된 프로그램. 스페인에서 칠레, 남아공에서 알래스카에 이르기까지 전 세계를 직접 발로 뛰며 제작되는 세계테마기행은 찬란한 문명 유적지와 자연유산은 물론 다양한 방식으로 삶을 영위해 가는 세계인들의 숨은 일상까지 생생히 보여준다

programme.title: 극한직업
programme.desc: 우리 사회에는 상상을 초월하는 극도로 힘든 작업환경 속에서 일하는 사람들이 있다. 이런 극한의 직업에 종사하는 사람들의 삶을 밀착 촬영하여 생생하게 보여줌으로써 역경을 극복하고 살아가고자 하는 사람들의 숭고한 의지와 잃어가고 있는 직업정신의 가치를 되돌아본다.

programme.title: 지식채널e
programme.desc: 과학, 생명, 문화유산, 가족, 교육, 직업, 한글등의 가치있는 수준높은 영상을 선사합니다. 지식채널e는 단순한 지식을 전달하는 프로그램이 아니라 지식을 바라보는 시각입니다. 시청자 여러분이 세상을 보는 많은 창들 중에 아주 작은 하나가 되기를 바랍니다.

programme.title: 지식채널e
programme.desc: 과학, 생명, 문화유산, 가족, 교육, 직업, 한글등의 가치있는 수준높은 영상을 선사합니다. 지식채널e는 단순한 지식을 전달하는 프로그램이 아니라 지식을 바라보는 시각입니다. 시청자 여러분이 세상을 보는 많은 창들 중에 아주 작은 하나가 되기를 바랍니다.

programme.title: 마샤와 곰
programme.desc: 조용한 시골마을에서 천방지축 꼬마소녀 마샤와 조용한 숲속의 덩치 큰 곰이 만나 일어나는 이야기를 그린 만화

programme.title: 소맥거핀 - 찰칵! 세계여행
programme.desc: 게임 속 몬스터인 랜디온들이 현실 세계에 나타났다! 세상을 구하기 위해 고군분투하는 소맥거핀 가족의 코믹 모험기

programme.title: 왔다! 내 손주
programme.desc: 해외에 거주하고 있어 자주 보지 못하는 손자, 손녀들과 할머니, 할아버지가 만나 보내는 며칠의 시간. 뭉클한 감동이 깃든 만남부터 그들에게 주어진 짧은 기간 일어나는 일들 속에 따듯한 가족애를 담아내는 프로그램

programme.title: 세계테마기행
programme.desc: 세계테마기행은 단순한 여행 정보 프로그램에서 벗어나, 자유로운 배낭여행자만이 느낄 수 있는 살아있는 체험기를 전해드리고자 기획된 프로그램. 스페인에서 칠레, 남아공에서 알래스카에 이르기까지 전 세계를 직접 발로 뛰며 제작되는 세계테마기행은 찬란한 문명 유적지와 자연유산은 물론 다양한 방식으로 삶을 영위해 가는 세계인들의 숨은 일상까지 생생히 보여준다

programme.title: EBS 다큐프라임
programme.desc: 아이의 사생활, 한반도의 공룡 등 많은 화제작과 동물, 음식, 여행 등 다양한 주제와 형식으로 남녀노소의 많은 사랑을 받고 있는 프로그램으로 시청자들의 지적욕구를 만족시켜 준다

programme.title: 중독자들
programme.desc: 스스로를 죽음의 길로 이끄는 중독. 중독 VS 중독, 내 몸의 해독을 위해 다른 중독이 필요하다. 같은 공간에서 중독에 대한 전혀 다른 인터뷰를 진행하며 중독의 늪에서 빠져나올 수 있도록 손을 잡아 준다!

programme.title: 아는 형님
programme.desc: 세상의 모든 질문을 그들만의 방식으로 풀어주는 아는 형님. 인생을 살다 보면 마주치게 되는 사소하지만 궁금해 견딜 수 없는 질문들. 그럴 땐 질문하라! 아는 형님이 답할 것이다.

programme.title: 냉장고를 부탁해 since 2014
programme.desc: 최고의 셰프들이 스타들의 냉장고 속 재료를 활용해 요리 대결을 펼치는 요리 토크쇼

programme.title: 친절한 진료실
programme.desc: 전문성은 기본, 환자 눈높이용 친절한 설명과 유머로 어려운 건강 정보도 쉽게 술술 당신의 건강 궁금증, lt친절한 진료실gt에서 밀착 진료해 드립니다.

programme.title: 세상에서 가장 아름다운 여행
programme.desc: 장애나 희귀병으로 고통받는 아이들과, 가난 때문에 치료를 포기 해야만 하는 위기에 처한 가정을 찾아가, 전문의, 심리학자, 상담사, 건축설계사 등 국내 최고의 전문가 그룹이 장애를 앓고 있는 어린이와 그 가정의 회복을 목표로 전문적이고 구체적인 해결 방안을 제시해준다 치료와 재활을 적극적으로 도와주는 솔루션 프로그램.

programme.title: 좋은아침 스페셜
programme.desc: 아침마다 전쟁아닌 전쟁을 치르는 우리 주부들이 잠시 한숨을 돌리며 자신만의 시간을 가질 수 있는 시간! 좋은아침과 함께 잠시의 행복한 데이트를 하며 차 한잔의 일상의 여유를 누려보자!

programme.title: 생활의 달인
programme.desc: 수십년간 한 분야에 종사하며 부단한 열정과 노력으로 달인의 경지에 이르게 된 사람들. 삶의 스토리와 리얼리티가 담겨 있는 생활 달인은 그 자체가 다큐멘터리. 비록 소박한 일이지만 평생을 통해 최고가 된 생활 달인의 놀라운 득도의 경지를 만나는 시간.

programme.title: 생방송 투데이
programme.desc: 뉴스에서 트렌드, 이벤트, 여가 생활정보에 이르기까지 시청자들이 궁금해 하는 모든 것을 알차고 재미있고 정확하게 전달하는 종합 정보 와이드 프로그램

programme.title: 생활의 달인
programme.desc: 수십년간 한 분야에 종사하며 부단한 열정과 노력으로 달인의 경지에 이르게 된 사람들. 삶의 스토리와 리얼리티가 담겨 있는 생활 달인은 그 자체가 다큐멘터리. 비록 소박한 일이지만 평생을 통해 최고가 된 생활 달인의 놀라운 득도의 경지를 만나는 시간.

programme.title: 사장님 귀는 당나귀 귀
programme.desc: 일할 맛 나는 일터를 만들기 위한 대한민국 보스들의 자발적 자아성찰 프로그램

programme.title: 영화가 좋다
programme.desc: 틀에 박힌 영화 홍보를 거부하면서, 시청자들이 직접 참여하여 영화 속 숨은 재미를 를 보다 즐겁게 소개하고 유익한 정보를 제공하는 영화 가이드 프로그램이다. 극장가를 뜨겁게 달구는 개봉 예정작, 리뷰, 영화 음악들 감독과 배우들의 진솔한 영화 이야기까지 함께 한다.

programme.title: 세상의 모든 다큐

programme.title: 동행
programme.desc: 우리 사회 어려운 이웃들의 아픔을 함께 나누고 희망의 길을 모색한다. 삶의 벼랑 끝에 몰린 우리 사회의 경제적 약자들을 위한 프로그램

programme.title: 세계는 지금 스페셜
programme.desc: 세계 곳곳에서 일어나고 있는 사건들을 알기 쉽게 소개해 주는 프로그램

programme.title: KBS 뉴스 5
programme.desc: 당일 발생한 국내외 주요뉴스를 종합 편성해 신속 보도.

programme.title: 동물의 왕국
programme.desc: BBC, 내셔널지오그래픽, NHK, 유럽의 최고 다큐제작사 등 세계 일류의 다큐멘터리 전문 제작사들이 제작한 고급 다큐멘터리들을 엄선하고, 우리말로 더빙하여 정확한 해설로 일반 시청자들에게 소개하여 생태계 이해를 돕는 국내 유일의 동물 전문 다큐멘터리이다.

programme.title: 6시 내고향

programme.title: 우리말 겨루기
programme.desc: 한글은 세계적으로 과학성을 인정받은 우리의 언어이다! 아름다운 말과 글로 유쾌하고 재미있는 퀴즈 쇼가 펼쳐진다. 우리말의 달인 도전! 우리말 달인 도전자가 우리말 달인에 도전을 하며 운명의 상금이 정해지는 퀴즈 쇼!

programme.title: KBS 뉴스 9
programme.desc: 당일발생 사안을 시청자들에게 신속히 전달하고 관련 현안을 종합 정리해 분석보도.

programme.title: 가요무대
programme.desc: 1985년부터 이어오고 있는 가요무대, 잔잔한 향수와 추억이 담겨있는 전통가요의 무대가 펼쳐진다.

programme.title: MBC 특별생방송 네팔 대홍수 절망을 넘어 희망으로

programme.title: 아기공룡 둘리
programme.desc: 아기공룡 둘리quot를 1983년부터 10년간 보물섬에서 연재하던 원작자 김수정씨는 국산 만화 캐릭터를 지속적이고, 세계적인 캐릭터로 성장 시키기 위해서는 조직적인 활동의 필요함을 느끼고 1995년 2월에 주둘리나라를 설립했다.1996년 7월 장편 만화영화 quot아기공룡 둘리quot를 제작하여 COEX 외 전국 극장에서 상영했으며 현재 미라클에서 비디오 테이프제작 판매중이다.1999년 1월 17일 베를린을 시작으로 독일극장에 상영했었고, 독일 영화개봉에 맞춰 음반 및 비디오, 게임도 같이 판매하는 큰 성과를 올렸다.

programme.desc: 귀신이 나오는 장소로 유명한 신비아파트, 그것도 444호에 이사 오게 된 하리네 가족. 첫날부터 그들은 자꾸만 이상한 일들에 휩싸이게 된다. 아무도 안 산다는 위층에선 밤새 쿵쿵거리는 소리가 울리고, 아파트 맨홀에서 기어 나온 괴상한 꼬마 아이는 자꾸만 내기를 하자며 하리에게 덤벼든다. 그러다 얼떨결에 꼬마 아이가 입에 달고 다니는 엿을 빼앗아 먹게 된 하리와 동생 두리. 그 이후부터 그들의 눈엔 하나둘 무서운 귀신의 모습이 보이기 시작하고, 정체를 알 수 없는 맨홀 꼬마는 귀신을 없애주면 원하는 소원은 뭐든지 이루어주겠다며 큰소리치는데...

programme.title: 세기의 부자 강연배틀쇼 사기꾼들
programme.desc: 대한민국 강연계 레전드들이 펼치는 강연배틀쇼 사기꾼들! 하나의 주제, 각기 다른 이야기로 벌이는 한 판 승부! 과연 최고의 사기꾼은 누가 될 것인가!

programme.title: 방금 놓친 탐정들의 영업비밀
programme.desc: 홈스, 코난처럼 대한민국에도 탐정이 있다? 집계된 탐정 수만 약 2만 명! 베일에 싸여있던 탐정들의 영업비밀 공개

programme.title: 속풀이쇼 동치미
programme.desc: 답답한 속을 동치미처럼 속시원하게 풀어주는 힐링 속풀이쇼.

programme.title: 오지GO
programme.desc: 오지의 아름다움과 원시 부족의 순수한 삶을 찾아 야생으로 떠난 발품 탐험기 오지 GO

programme.title: 삼국지덕후콘서트
programme.desc: 상상초월 초특급 게스트로 다시 돌아온 삼국지 인문학 토크쇼. 연예인, 작가, 국회의원, 등 각양각색의 인사들이 게스트로 출연해, 자신들이 종사해온 분야에서 쌓아온 탄탄한 내공을 바탕으로 삼국지를 바라보는 신선한 관점을 제시할 lt삼국지 덕후 콘서트gt! 자타공인 삼국지 덕후들의 살벌한 삼국지 썰전이 펼쳐집니다.

programme.title: YTN 24
programme.desc: 뉴스 채널 YTN의 기본축을 이루는 뉴스 프로그램. 정확성과 속보성을 최대한 살려 최신 정보를 필요로하는 시청자들의 욕구를 만족시켜 준다. 특히 뉴스 휠 방식을 도입함으로써 그 날의 주요 뉴스와 함께 방송시간 직전까지 기자들이 송고한 최신 소식을 매시간 뉴스 편집에 반영함으로써 가장 생생한 소식을 시청자들에게 전달한다. 또 진행 중인 사건, 사고의 변화되는 상황을 그때 그때 전달해 뉴스에 대한 시청자들의 궁금증을 해소하고 전반적인 변화에 대한 시청자들의 이해를 돕는다.

programme.title: 암살
programme.desc: 1933년 상하이와 경성을 배경으로 친일파 암살작전을 둘러싼 독립군과 임시정부 대원, 그들을 쫓는 청부 살인업자의 이야기

programme.title: 킬빌 2
programme.desc: 전편 lt킬빌gt의 속편인 쿠엔틴 타란티노 감독의 영화킬빌 2는 여성 킬러의 복수극을 잔혹하게 그린 폭력 액션물로, lt펄프 픽션gt의 우마 서먼과 lt미녀 삼총사gt의 루시 루가 열연하였다. 국내 개봉 당시 잔혹한 폭력 장면으로 화제가 된 영화.

programme.title: 군도:민란의 시대
programme.desc: 억압에 맞서 세상을 바꾸고자 일어선 의적들과 백성을 수탈하는 탐관 오리의 한 판 승부를 그린 액션 활극

programme.title: 글로벌 코리안
programme.desc: 해외 동포들의 삶과 현안들을 현지통신원을 통해 알아본다.

programme.title: 끝나지 않는 총성, 전쟁 그 후
자막 널 사랑할 생각은 없어라던 차기 공작님이 어째선지 제게 푹 빠졌어요
자막 이세계에서 복슬복슬을 쓰담쓰담하기 위해 노력 중입니다
紫釵奇緣
programme.desc: 紫釵一錯誤終身，才子佳人各天涯，情深難敵功名路，回首已成舊夢痕根據明代戲曲家湯顯祖的經典名著紫釵記改編而成，講述了大唐年間，歌舞名妓霍小玉風流俠客納蘭東書香才子李益和巾幗紅顏盧靖瀾為首的風騷人物，彼此錯綜複雜的命運與感情糾葛一場指腹為婚的誤會，造成浪漫卻無果的錯點鴛鴦，他們在階級差異與強權壓迫中勇於追求真愛，在宮廷權謀與世俗現實的拉扯中身不由己地被推向命運的叉路，自此展開一段關於愛背叛與救贖的傳奇故事

programme.title: 大漢盛世
programme.desc: 鐵腕定江山，仁德治天下，開創大漢文景盛世氣象西元201年，布衣天子劉邦擊敗西楚霸王項羽，建立了大漢王朝為鞏固皇權，誅滅韓信英布等異姓功臣，並應對匈奴威脅呂后專權後朝政動盪，直至誅呂之亂，性情仁厚長期鎮守代地的劉恒被推立為帝，是為漢文帝文帝即位後，以仁政安民，推行輕徭薄賦與民休息，抑制功臣與諸侯勢力，整頓吏治，重用賢才，推動農業與法制改革，同時安撫邊疆抵禦匈奴在權力與親情間多有取捨，含淚處置親族以穩國本最終奠定文景之治基礎，使漢室走向長治久安

programme.title: 大盛魁
programme.desc: 電視連續劇大盛魁由創業興業歇業三部一百集構成，歷史跨度270年由三個獨立完整的故事構成講述了王相卿張傑史大學等三個赤手空拳創業的故事

programme.title: 步步驚心
programme.desc: 張曉的命運被一場車禍徹底改寫她看著失控的卡車將自己的靈魂撞出了軀體，而她沒有進醫院也沒有進天堂，卻是被撞進了清朝的宮廷中就像穿越小說裏寫的那樣，張曉的靈魂跨時間隧道，一個叫若曦的十六歲清朝女孩的體內重生一場震動歷史的九龍奪嫡正暗潮湧動權利的廝殺，愛情的灼燒，被無限放大的歷史舞臺上，若曦的命運無可避免的與眾位阿哥們交織在一起她知道自己不該捲入這場九王奪嫡爭鬥中，可心不由己，因為這裡有所愛的，也有愛她的若曦最後選擇的是溫潤如玉的八阿哥，還是面冷心熱的四阿哥，又或是出人意料的其他人？

programme.title: 善德女王
programme.desc: 利用美色掌握宮中權力的美室，一心想成為王后，雖然摩耶王后在她的詭計下死裡逃生，還身懷六甲回到宮中，但摩耶王后懷的雙胞胎卻成就不幸的宿命，因為王室流傳一個預言御出雙生，聖骨男盡，意指王室若生出雙胞胎，將使王室男性斷了精氣真平王深知要是王后生下雙胞胎的事實曝光，一家人將會有無止盡的災難，於是命宮女昭火偷偷將其中一個女兒帶出王宮多年後被拋棄的公主德曼回到新羅，與雙胞胎姐姐天明公主同心協力對抗美室美室企圖用各種手段羅織罪名於德曼公主和天明公主，天明公主於一場追捕德曼的陰謀計畫下意外身亡，原本只想逃出新羅的德曼公主因為天明公主的死開始藉著聰慧的頭腦與身旁各方勢力的協助，最終擊垮政敵美室，成為第一個登上新羅王位的女性

programme.desc: 張曉的命運被一場車禍徹底改寫她看著失控的卡車將自己的靈魂撞出了軀體，而她沒有進醫院也沒有進天堂，卻是被撞進了清朝的宮廷中就像穿越小說裏寫的那樣，張曉的靈魂跨時間隧道，一個叫若曦的十六歲清朝女孩的體內重生一場震動歷史的九龍奪嫡正暗潮湧動權利的廝殺，愛情的灼燒，被無限放大的歷史舞臺上，若曦的命運無可避免的與眾位阿哥們交織在一起她知道自己不該捲入這場九王奪嫡爭鬥中，可心不由己，因為這裡有所愛的，也有愛她的若曦最後選擇的是溫潤如玉的八阿哥，還是面冷心熱的四阿哥，又或是出人意料的其他人？

programme.title: 神偷大劫案
programme.desc: 轟動全球價值高達300億的鑽石太陽之淚驚傳在澳門現蹤，混跡賭場的盜賊澳門朴從韓國找來多年前被他拋下的一眾夥伴以及香港的一幫大盜齊聚澳門，身懷絕技的眾人看似為了奪取鑽石團結一線，背地裡卻暗潮洶湧伺機而動一顆鑽石一幫老千，一場用盡各種招數偷拐搶騙的驚險暗戰蓄勢待發

programme.title: 五億探長雷洛傳I：雷老虎
programme.desc: 香港警界中，提起雷洛（劉德華飾）這個名字，真是膾炙人口，黑白兩道人稱的洛哥，充滿著傳奇性雷洛剛從警校畢業時，為人正直，不恥於收受黑錢，後來因女友阿霞的父親要求雷洛以五萬元作聘金，雷洛開始了他的受賄生涯

programme.title: 五億探長雷洛傳II：父子情仇
programme.desc: 五億探長雷洛傳續集，得到岳父之助東山再起的雷洛（劉德華飾）），在警界鬥爭後升上全港總華探長，坐擁大權香港展開反貪污大行動，雷洛卻在此時遇上了失散的舊情人與擔任廉政專員的兒子（郭富城飾），展開一場父子鬥爭

programme.title: 黃飛鴻之鐵雞鬥蜈蚣
programme.desc: 黃飛鴻結識尋找妹妹的鐵燕父女，鐵燕父女發現朝廷的捕快正和僧人在商議販賣人口的計策但不料行蹤被發現，結果父親被打傷，女兒只好逃出去向黃飛鴻求救

programme.title: 金錢帝國：追虎擒龍
programme.desc: 1973年，香港警察與黑道勾結，貪污巨利，荼毒市民港督終於決定成立廉政公署，由黑白雙煞陳克和白松安組成第一批廉政公署調查員，調查權傾黑白兩道的總華探長徐樂及黑道霸主跛豪，嚴厲打擊香港的地下規則和貪污的大老虎，兩人聯手出擊，出現了打貪成效，但也因徐樂與跛豪決定合作對抗廉政公署，更有不少廉署成員相繼遇害，但陳克不放棄信念，一場正義與邪惡的爭鬥，從此拉開了帷幕

programme.title: 導演你有病新
programme.desc: 在電影拍攝期間，導演竟離奇失蹤，隨著警方調查，每一個工作人員都頗有嫌疑原來籌拍時，老闆志明請來有好萊塢經驗的倪有彬擔任導演，但出資老闆金董卻只願投資十萬，電影公司只好節省預算，一堆荒謬離奇的狀況就此上演

programme.title: 驚天大營救
programme.desc: 親眼目睹妻兒遇害的白安決心復仇，他孤身混入黑幫暗中調查，才發現妻子意外得知黑幫犯罪的關鍵而慘遭毒手，種種線索不僅暗示這背後有著巨大陰謀，更指向商業大賈賀英豪沒想到賀英豪突然失蹤，賀英豪之女賀婷更決定與一心殺父的白安結盟，各懷鬼胎的兩人要在黑警毒梟的追捕下殺出重圍，找出賀英豪

programme.title: 變種人幽靈戰姬
programme.desc: 吳晴晴是國際安全聯盟組織的特工，奉命潛入美杜莎整形醫院搜集犯罪證據她成功潛入，卻意外被強行注射藥劑，受到藥劑的影響擁有了無異於幽靈般的詭異速度，犯罪組織得知此事更是傾盡所有力量追殺吳晴晴，她是否能運用幽靈絕地反擊呢？

programme.title: 遊戲爆報新
programme.desc: 遊戲爆報新

programme.title: 夢遊樂園
programme.desc: 衰事不斷的台生突發奇想，借來一棟豪華別墅，火速帶著女兒美樂老婆慧敏入住，為全家改運一家三口看似迎接美好新生活，但屋內過時的裝潢仿若早已質變的家庭生活，隨時崩離16歲的美樂無法相信眼前的一家和樂，竟是父母刻意粉飾太平，挫敗的她逃到荒廢的兒童樂園，沉溺在她幻想出的奇異世界懸月王國，並越陷越深

programme.title: 素還真
programme.desc: 霹靂布袋戲主人翁素還真起源故事一人三化的由來，未公開的白蓮秘辛且看素還真如何力挽狂瀾，阻止兇徒野心，如何仗劍而行，在江湖中走出自己的路，一個屬於霹靂的傳奇，即將誕生

programme.title: 甜蜜殺機
programme.desc: 資深刑警王志毅辦案效率奇差，卻天生有閃避危險任務的神準第六感警察署長的女兒高依萍一心想當警察，擔心愛女安危的署長靈機一動，下令王志毅與她搭檔，兩人水火不容，更被分配到調查可愛小狗死亡這種輕鬆差事沒想到這樁案件竟誤打誤撞，讓兩人追查到了警局通緝要犯的下落，更牽扯出一串驚天動地的謀殺案！

programme.title: 黃飛鴻92之龍行天下
programme.desc: 黃飛鴻的現代版，李連杰主演國術專家陳厚德移民美國，開設寶芝林醫館，大弟子杰前來探望，卻被黑幫尋仇，杰被偷襲，好友被綁架，生命岌岌可危片中李連杰拳腳灑洒地展現少林武學，特別是最後一場英雄救美，衝上雲霄，清理門戶，動作清脆利落，令人嘆為觀止！

programme.title: 至尊無上II之永霸天下
programme.desc: 凡獲賭神金牌，必可得其相助擁有一金牌之范老大因被大徒弟Tommy出賣而慘死，小徒弟希望剛出獄的二師兄杰對付Tommy，但遭拒絕後Tommy為尋賭神金牌而苦苦相迫，杰終忍無可忍，決清理門戶

programme.title: 孤男寡女
programme.desc: 華少是一間電腦零件公司的營業經理，雖事業成功，但在感情路上卻是徹頭徹尾的失敗者Kinki是公司內的營業員，人生最大的目標就是找個好歸宿，可惜男朋友阿Dan卻是花心蘿蔔Kinki被調到了華少的部門，無意間幫了華少一個大忙，令華少對她刮目相看，二人的友誼亦在不知不覺間滋長但華少前女友茵突然現身欲與華少重修舊好，並介紹美國鉅富Roger給Kinki，華少這才驚覺自己不知不覺中已愛上Kinki

programme.title: 不能說的秘密
programme.desc: 高中生葉湘倫出身單親家庭，熱愛音樂並且琴藝過人某日，班上來了一位同樣喜愛彈琴的新同學路小雨，投緣的兩人形影不離，情感也日漸加溫，然而小雨總是相當神祕，還常彈奏一首未曾問世，但優美動聽的曲子每當小倫想多了解小雨一些，她常欲言又止，只都推說是秘密但有一天，在一場誤會發生後，小雨再也沒來上過課，思念小雨又一頭霧水的小倫決心要找出這個不能說的秘密

programme.title: 赤狐書生
programme.desc: 清貧書生王子進赴京趕考途中，遇見下凡取丹的小狐妖白十三白十三為了晉升狐仙，假意陪王子進趕考，實則要讓王子進主動獻出丹前往京城的路途遙遠又充滿危險，一人一狐相互扶持共患難，成了莫逆之交歷盡萬險，終於到了白十三在友情與成仙之間作出抉擇的時刻

programme.title: 門徒
programme.desc: 阿力用了八年時間，從一名小小的毒品批發商混到壟斷海洛英市場的莊家身旁，負責處理出貨及運輸工作多年以來阿力全心全意搜集完整販毒資料，但行事小心的莊家從未透露後來莊家萌生退休之意並意欲交棒給阿力接管，於是帶阿力到金三角，對阿力做出接棒前的最後試探，一場鬥智的過程，使阿力獲得莊家的絕對信任，阿力也漸漸掌控經營販毒的秘密

programme.title: 穿越未知世界
programme.desc: 不斷輪迴的結果，她要如何逃脫？珍被困在一個無限重覆的未知世界裡，在歷劫過程中，意外發現了某項神秘的人類實驗

programme.title: 奮戰到底
programme.desc: 從ISIS偵詢中倖存的兩名海軍陸戰隊員返家，克里斯努力回歸正常生活，貝爾又回到了多年前熟悉的混合武術世界，尋找值得為之生存的戰鬥值得背水一戰的未來，離開戰事的軍員還能找到生存的價值嗎？

programme.title: 龍轉戰局
programme.desc: 人類生存的希望寄託在傳說中滅絕的生物！一個孤獨的騎士試圖組建一支軍隊來對抗惡魔領主，傳說中的巨龍是他們抵禦的最後希望，但這種生物真的存在嗎？如果是這樣，牠會再次為人民而戰嗎？

programme.title: 殲滅戰1941
programme.desc: 改編自二戰哈薩克名人阿迪沙里波夫的真實故事阿迪沙里波夫中尉與他的軍團在敵軍戰線的包圍下撤退未知的恐懼襲來，他們意識到毫不作為的等待將會比敵人的子彈更加致命

programme.title: 我的王子老爸
programme.desc: 吉比的人生完全奉獻給八歲的女兒索菲亞他每天最期待的事情，就是睡前跟女兒分享自己悉心創作的床邊故事；在故事裡的幻想世界，他總是化身英勇的王子，一次次拯救陷入危險的女兒三年後，吉比發現即將進入青春期的索菲亞已不再著迷於他的床邊故事，她開始編織屬於自己的故事，而吉比在這些故事裡越來越不重要為了避免失去在女兒心中的地位，他開始嘗試瞭解女兒的人際關係和內心世界，希望重新成為女兒人生的主角

programme.title: 環遊世界大冒險
programme.desc: 這是史上最傳奇的冒險故事，英勇的麥哲倫與意外結識的艾爾卡諾毅然踏上環遊世界的旅程，並從此改變了歷史兩人帶領船隊經過了各個大陸島嶼，在遙遠神秘的島嶼發現了珍貴的香料和稀奇古怪的動植物，也經歷許多生死一瞬間的危險，面對飢餓暴風雨充滿敵意的原始部落，究竟麥哲倫能否成功環繞世界一周，顛覆人們的傳統觀念呢？

programme.title: 絕命3小時
programme.desc: 曾是歷史地標的堡高醫院，荒廢已久並面臨即將拆除的命運，但某幫派卻在此藏了九千萬，隨著消息傳開，兩個敵對黑幫虎視眈眈，想要找出這筆贓款，未料卻被拆除工人麥可搶先發現，而距離建物爆破拆除期限僅剩短短三小時

programme.title: 逃出敘利亞
programme.desc: 卡里姆在經過多年的戰鬥後，離開了飽受戰爭蹂躪的敘利亞他過去犯下的暴力行為，依然如影隨形地跟著他往後的人生他返回義大利後，立即加入了一個恐怖組織，在那裡他作為一名戰士而享有盛譽然而，一切並不像看起來的那樣，因為警察和安全部門也暗中與卡里姆聯繫究竟他是義大利的雙重間諜，還是效忠於恐怖組織的危險人物？

programme.title: 獵魔者
programme.desc: 西元811年，一個困苦家庭孤立地住在距離比爾卡好幾天路程的森林深處父親喬爾迫於生活壓力，開始到各村莊掠奪，卻久未返家，大女兒露娜開始接手家中事務一天，露娜在外出打獵時發現一個受傷昏迷的戰士並帶回家照料當男子痊癒後，她才知道他是被派來保護家人免受邪惡之害，而且他帶來了父親的消息

programme.title: 戰朝
programme.desc: 十五世紀的歐亞大陸上，偉大的成吉思汗後裔們創建了自己的民族傳說中的阿布哈爾沙巴尼，從部落中奪取了權力兩名正統的王位繼承人克雷和扎尼貝克，呼籲各個游牧部族遠離這個危險的統治者，並遷徙到蒙古，復興了古老的哈薩克汗國然而在這片和平自由的應許之地，敵人正悄悄覬覦哈薩克汗國，等待著他們的，是一場腥風血雨的嚴峻考驗

programme.title: 製騙追殺令
programme.desc: 一棟殺氣重重的成人片製片廠，一場緊張又荒謬的生存之戰即將展開！阿奇斯是個常進出監獄的小混混，在前獄友強力邀約下出演假影片來挽救一名富豪的商譽殺青後，阿奇斯居然成為黑幫大哥出身的導演要刪除的角色！？被困在成人片製片廠的他無所不用其極，牙刷道具竟成了他的防身武器，現在他欠的是生機！

programme.title: 打不死的男人
programme.desc: 不敗英雄范達美曾是家喻戶曉的動作巨星，邁入中年的他卻光環不再：打戲NG連連稅務問題及離婚官司纏身女兒更向他抱怨過氣明星老爸讓她好尷尬！這天，分身乏術又急需用錢的他直奔銀行，沒過多久卻驚傳陣陣槍響，在警匪對峙期間，范達美幾句簡短說詞更啟人疑竇，這樁搶案真正的搶匪到底是誰？

programme.title: 無間交戰
programme.desc: 自幼是孤兒的他從未感受過家庭的溫暖或羈絆，身份是資深警探的他被派到當地最龐大的販毒集團裡進行滲透，這個由阿拉伯家族掌管的組織作風強悍血腥，在前方等著他的，除了掙扎與考驗外，是黑白兩道界線的含糊

programme.title: 攔截永生碼
programme.desc: 為了青春永駐，你願付出多少代價？跨時代發明的永生技術將思想轉移到新的身體上問世之後，開發者布里琪發現，其中一個原型有著重大的缺陷，準備要將研究成果下架，但家人陸續被綁架，她才意識到，自己已經踏入一場生死交關的非法交易

programme.title: 終極快遞
programme.desc: 在巴黎街頭，有個使命必達的飆速快遞員，他就是SamSam每天騎著速克達穿梭大街小巷使命必達，但他的摳門老闆從不給他加薪，還有個警察老爸成天跟他作對等著開罰單女友Nadia是他最大精神支柱，未料就在Nadia姊姊大婚之日，一趟稀鬆不過的送貨任務，竟滾出麻煩的大雪球，成了無法脫身的街頭追逐戰眼看另一頭女友已急跳腳，再不快趕去婚禮現場，Sam還看得到明天的太陽嗎？

programme.title: 危機搶救
programme.desc: 里科與他的母親為了逃離毒品圈，非法移民到別的國家，可是在他母親得到癌症後，他必須重新回到那個世界賺取治療費用

programme.title: 終極殺陣2：雷霆霹靂
programme.desc: 飆速計程車重現江湖啦！丹尼爾初次與岳父母共進午餐，適逢日本國防部長出訪法國，身為國防部長的岳父必須親自到機場迎接，丹尼爾的首要任務就是在飛機降落之前將岳父平安送達機場不料順利完成任務後，警探好友艾米里再度擾局，原來日本國防部長竟被恐怖份子綁架了！為了搶救日本國防部長並挽回法國的國際形象，艾米里只好再度請出飛車駕駛丹尼爾協助破案！

programme.title: 靈犬雪麗
programme.desc: 男孩小恩與爺爺住在阿爾卑斯山上一天，村民認為有隻流浪大白熊犬咬死羊隻，準備驅離牠，純真的小恩深信牠不是兇手，不僅挺身而出保護牠，更幫牠命名雪麗，一人一狗成為最佳拍檔，形影不離直到納粹德軍來到山上，雪麗因為小恩竟咬傷德軍，村民決定殺死牠小恩和雪麗能否逃過一劫，繼續守護彼此呢？

programme.title: 香米小情歌
programme.desc: 年輕貌美的美國科學家琳達被公司派往印度銷售她所培育的9號稻米初次來到印度的琳達飽受文化衝擊，遇到一位因為繳不出學費而輟學的大學生羅傑，兩人卻在研究與爭執過程當中陷入熱戀，羅傑也幫她發現被派往印度的醜陋內幕，原來她想要幫助印度農民的研究成果，竟不知不覺地被無良公司濫用，即將對農民造成毀滅性的傷害！琳達該要如何阻止這場災難？而她與羅傑的異國戀又將會開花結果嗎？

programme.title: 驚天盜數
programme.desc: 維克多是一名小偷，俄羅斯黑幫成員希望他執行一樁搶案，然而維克多對這群新朋友的銀行搶劫計畫並不放心就在眾人準備下手時，國際刑警組織的特工殺死了黑幫成員並逮捕維克多，而負責搶案的司機毒蟲拉沛多卻在維克多的協助下逃走事實上維克多是名臥底警察，但隨著臥底行動終止而被吊銷職位並面臨調查，在心灰意冷之際，維克多決定沿用黑幫計劃，與拉沛多一起搶劫銀行

programme.title: 西部殺陣
programme.desc: 前軍人勒邁過去的任務曾撲殺夏安族人，也因此被夏安族首領詛咒，預言他將被自己的孩子殺死勒邁深怕預言成真，開始尋找失散的孩子們，為避免被他們殺死，勒邁先將他們一一殺害，直到剩下最後一個兒子卡爾卡爾本身也是一個不法之徒，受到賞金獵人和警察的追捕勒邁必須設法阻止他的兒子，並終結這場詛咒

programme.title: 朋友再見
programme.desc: 自阿爾及利亞戰場歸來，法國醫官巴宏和外籍軍團傭兵波普同在營區等待除役而相識，種下了莫名的兄弟情誼巴宏為了完成軍中友人生前承諾，答應其女友伊莎貝爾，利用即將到來的聖誕長假潛入公司保險櫃放回一筆價值不菲的債券，波普也恰在同時找上巴宏，二人竟被鎖在公司金庫中！原來看似單純的偷天換日計劃其實是場大騙局，哥倆好陷入謀殺劫案中，該如何信守男人間的約定來扭轉頹勢？

programme.title: 龍在少林
programme.desc: 一身好功夫但童心未泯的小龍，被師父派下山尋找佛緣，不幸與師兄失散，還好遇到了流浪兒肥蟲，才不至於挨餓受凍隨後二人又碰到了英雄救美的古董愛好者一山，意外得知一山的兄弟正在盜賣小龍師父的寺院丟失的佛首，便和被一山救下的少女小萱，一同踏上了尋回佛首之路

programme.title: 爆破死亡谷
programme.desc: 二戰後期，已節節敗退的納粹德國為求反敗為勝，希特勒下令全力發展秘密報復性武器倫敦方面由於情報有限，軍方於是啟動十字弓計畫，選派具語言與科學專長的人員訓練為特工，潛入德國地下工廠蒐集情資當一連串的未知武器輪番來襲造成英國軍民一片恐慌，盟軍的一切希望就寄託在這些特工身上！

programme.title: 死亡塔
programme.desc: 一代宗師李振強和武林高手秦谷是生死之交，秦谷的猝逝讓李振強決心找到背後的真兇，卻不幸遇害，只留下了一個和死亡塔有關的秘密振強的弟弟振國得知兄長死訊後，追隨着振強留下的線索來到神秘山莊內潛藏的宮殿，等待著他的竟然是正是秦谷，原來振強與振國都落入了秦谷一手策劃的陰謀漩渦之中

programme.title: 一閃一閃亮星星
programme.desc: 學霸張萬森打算向暗戀已久的女孩林北星表白，但一場演唱會事故，讓他的告白計劃變成了無法挽回的悲劇痛苦的張萬森意外倒轉時光，回到悲劇發生前的林北星身邊，試圖逆轉一切避免悲劇再次發生這一次，拼盡全力的張萬森能否成功守護林北星，讓所有的遺憾得以圓滿？

programme.title: 哥吉拉對黑多拉
programme.desc: 日本駿河灣接連發生不明物體撞沉船隻事件而漁民在此都捕不到漁獲，海洋生物學家矢野教授受託前往海灣調查，卻遭到怪物襲擊矢野教授檢測檢體發現禍源乃是一種以汙染物為食的無機外星生物，這狀似蝌蚪的泥漿獸被稱為黑多拉不久黑多拉上岸肆虐，感應到威脅的哥吉拉適時出現，地球的命運將會如何呢？

programme.title: 李祘3-4
programme.desc: 李祘3-4

programme.title: 野蠻真相
programme.desc: 一位邊境治安官負責管理一座帝國邊境的小城鎮，他們與蠻族交換物資，彼此和平共處，不料喬爾上校的到來讓局勢失去了平衡喬爾上校殘暴地拷問壓迫和虐待蠻族，為了滿足帝國擴張的野心，他甚至編造蠻族意圖入侵的證據，而持反對意見的治安官也被指控與蠻族勾結帝國軍隊的種種暴行讓治安官痛苦不堪，進而讓他展開一段自我探索的旅程

programme.title: 血染雪山堡
programme.desc: 二戰中期盟軍重要人物－美國卡納比將軍，座機在德奧邊界墜毀被俘，就近被囚禁在阿爾卑斯山中地勢險惡的鷹堡英國軍情六處特納上校立即派遣以特工史密斯少校為首與美軍謝弗中尉等精通德語的七人突擊隊，假扮德軍深入敵營搶救但在空降時通訊士意外喪命，不久又有兩名成員離奇身亡，更離譜的是謝弗中尉從史密斯少校口中得知，卡納比將軍竟是由演員所扮演！這艱鉅的鷹堡搶救任務，究竟還隱藏著甚麼更大的陰謀？

programme.title: 李祘5-6
programme.desc: 李祘5-6

programme.title: 江湖女間諜
programme.desc: 來自愛爾蘭的瑪麗亞一號，從小隨著革命家父親為反對英國統治而四處進行破壞一次行動中父親不幸喪命，她誤打誤撞躲藏在馬戲團，遇到法國來的瑪麗亞二號為了幫她逃避英軍追捕，兩個瑪麗亞結成表演組合，因大膽表演迅速爆紅一次表演後，瑪麗亞二號邂逅了革命首腦弗洛雷斯並為其偉大情操打動，但弗洛雷斯卻不幸被獨裁者追捕射殺，瑪麗亞二號便繼承其遺志，號召村民展開抗爭，瑪麗亞一號也憑多年經驗來幫助平民百姓

programme.title: 逃學歪傳
programme.desc: 育才書院F.4D班學生素來調皮，荒廢學業，不少教師也被他們弄走當中學生一健在校內橫行無忌，甚至連主任也不敢招惹他剛到任的張老師卻能馴服他們，改善了師生關係，但一場球賽又把一健捲入打鬥漩渦，張更為此面臨被解僱的命運，究竟F.4D班如何合力解決此事？

programme.title: 雷瑪根鐵橋
programme.desc: 二戰末期盟軍已攻至德境萊茵河彼岸直指德國心臟地帶，猶作困獸之鬥的希特勒下令炸毀各座跨河大橋，而盟軍也計畫炸橋後可將德軍分隔兩岸削弱其兵力納粹軍官克魯格少校奉命至雷瑪根擔任萊茵河最後一座鐵橋的守備指揮官，肩負最後一刻執行炸橋的艱鉅任務，然而到任後克魯格發現德軍因敗退而軍令紊亂，正規部隊早已被調往他處，後備部隊只剩不到二百人，更糟的是連炸橋用的炸藥都還遲遲未能送達

programme.title: 神鬼二勢力
programme.desc: 兩位出沒於墨西哥的辣妹俠盜以銀行為目標，劫富濟貧頻頻得手，成為家喻戶曉的傳奇而她們真正的敵人，其實是已將魔爪漸漸深入小鎮的邪惡勢力！

programme.title: 雷鳥神機隊之太空歷險記
programme.desc: 21世紀中葉，人類首次火星登陸探險任務Zero-X太空船即將發射，邪惡的假面人胡德卻藏身於太空船內進行破壞導致失敗二年後，火星任務再度展開，由國際救援隊雷鳥神機隊出面維護發射安全，Zero-X成功踏上火星之旅，但火星上未知的生命體已蠢蠢欲動，Zero-X上的五名探險隊員們將要如何安全返回地球？雷鳥神機隊，出發！

programme.title: 庖丁傳奇之金刀御廚
programme.desc: 民以食為天，八大菜系中佛跳牆之由來有各種傳説，本故事即以兩位廚師及其後人經歷各種磨難，涅槃重生，創造此經典閩菜之過程

programme.title: 李祘5-6
programme.desc: 李祘5-6

programme.title: 越南大戰
programme.desc: 美國綠扁帽特種部隊麥克科比上校被調派至南越政府軍的聯合前線基地輪替指揮官一職，但北越軍方亦試圖要奪取這尚未建構完善的戰略要地，雙方持續處於血腥的拉鋸戰，悲慘的卻是夾縫中的百姓上校除奮勇率隊作戰，更協助醫護安置百姓，秘密行動即將展開，任務是深入敵後擄走掌控整個越共軍力的北越將軍

programme.title: 被告人
programme.desc: 話題冠軍韓劇，正義檢察官池晟孤軍奮戰尋找真凶！！最強正義檢察官朴政宇，被冤枉殺害妻女入獄及事件發生後失去了記憶，成為了被告人為了洗刷背負的嫌疑罪名而不得不在獄中拼湊記憶與找出殺害妻女的真凶，這時他也進入人生最糟糕的兩難選擇，陷入檢察官的鬥爭中

programme.title: 紅色高跟鞋雙語版
programme.desc: 狠心母拋家嫁富豪 棄子重生 只為揭穿母親真面目一段因愛與慾望而撕裂的親情，點燃了跨越二十年的復仇烈火年輕時的熙瓊為追逐榮華，狠心拋夫棄子，投入舊情人赫相懷抱，卻一步步被權力與野心吞噬她的女兒珍瑪在父親離世母親棄養的陰影下成長，懷著深深怨恨潛入熙瓊身邊，以設計師與繼孫女的身分逐步揭穿母親的虛偽面具母女之間愛恨交織，真相與謊言親情與仇恨輪番交鋒，最終將迎來一場足以摧毀一切的命運對決

programme.title: 魔女之城雙語版
programme.desc: 婆媳小姑撕破臉！命運抓弄下的同居奇蹟一場毀滅性的家庭變故，讓原本關係緊繃的離婚婆婆媳婦與小姑，命運交織地被迫同住在一個屋簷下撕下以往的對立標籤，三個性格迥異傷痕累累的女人在滿是摩擦與衝突的日常中，漸漸看清彼此的脆弱她們相互扶持攜手抵禦人生的逆境風浪，最終走出陰霾，共築出比血緣更堅固的暖心情誼！

programme.title: 小歡喜
programme.desc: 望子成龍！ 都會家庭的高考大作戰 以三個家庭為主軸，方圓和童文潔一家三口，他們的兒子方一凡即將面臨高考，但父母的壓力與兒子的無憂形成鮮明對比，使得家庭關係逐漸緊張另一方面，單親媽媽宋倩與女兒喬英子的生活也充滿了挑戰，前夫的糾纏和女兒的叛逆讓她左右為難最後，季楊楊從小被寄養在舅舅家，父母突然的關懷讓他陷入矛盾，父親季勝利努力與他建立親子關係，但結果並不理想這些家庭的故事交織在一起，展現了現代都市生活中家庭親情和成長的種種困境和溫暖時刻

programme.title: 木蘭復仇記首
programme.desc: 家破人亡張天愛女扮男裝！逆襲成女元帥盛國公之女阿麥目睹至親慘遭滅門，女扮男裝隱姓埋名，從貧民窟設局保命到混入軍營浴血奮戰！她憑藉絕妙陣法與過人膽識，在硝煙中一戰成名，從柔弱孤女蛻變為令敵軍聞風喪膽的鎮北軍元帥面對深陷權謀的帝王情愛宿敵常鈺青的真心追求，阿麥看破情鎖，毅然拒入後宮，率領軍民駐守靖陽劃地獨立，霸氣活出不靠男人的大女主傳奇！

programme.title: 木蘭復仇記
programme.desc: 家破人亡張天愛女扮男裝！逆襲成女元帥盛國公之女阿麥目睹至親慘遭滅門，女扮男裝隱姓埋名，從貧民窟設局保命到混入軍營浴血奮戰！她憑藉絕妙陣法與過人膽識，在硝煙中一戰成名，從柔弱孤女蛻變為令敵軍聞風喪膽的鎮北軍元帥面對深陷權謀的帝王情愛宿敵常鈺青的真心追求，阿麥看破情鎖，毅然拒入後宮，率領軍民駐守靖陽劃地獨立，霸氣活出不靠男人的大女主傳奇！

programme.title: 小歡喜
programme.desc: 望子成龍！ 都會家庭的高考大作戰 以三個家庭為主軸，方圓和童文潔一家三口，他們的兒子方一凡即將面臨高考，但父母的壓力與兒子的無憂形成鮮明對比，使得家庭關係逐漸緊張另一方面，單親媽媽宋倩與女兒喬英子的生活也充滿了挑戰，前夫的糾纏和女兒的叛逆讓她左右為難最後，季楊楊從小被寄養在舅舅家，父母突然的關懷讓他陷入矛盾，父親季勝利努力與他建立親子關係，但結果並不理想這些家庭的故事交織在一起，展現了現代都市生活中家庭親情和成長的種種困境和溫暖時刻

programme.title: 被告人
programme.desc: 話題冠軍韓劇，正義檢察官池晟孤軍奮戰尋找真凶！！最強正義檢察官朴政宇，被冤枉殺害妻女入獄及事件發生後失去了記憶，成為了被告人為了洗刷背負的嫌疑罪名而不得不在獄中拼湊記憶與找出殺害妻女的真凶，這時他也進入人生最糟糕的兩難選擇，陷入檢察官的鬥爭中

programme.title: 紅色高跟鞋雙語版
programme.desc: 狠心母拋家嫁富豪 棄子重生 只為揭穿母親真面目一段因愛與慾望而撕裂的親情，點燃了跨越二十年的復仇烈火年輕時的熙瓊為追逐榮華，狠心拋夫棄子，投入舊情人赫相懷抱，卻一步步被權力與野心吞噬她的女兒珍瑪在父親離世母親棄養的陰影下成長，懷著深深怨恨潛入熙瓊身邊，以設計師與繼孫女的身分逐步揭穿母親的虛偽面具母女之間愛恨交織，真相與謊言親情與仇恨輪番交鋒，最終將迎來一場足以摧毀一切的命運對決

programme.title: 魔女之城雙語版
programme.desc: 婆媳小姑撕破臉！命運抓弄下的同居奇蹟一場毀滅性的家庭變故，讓原本關係緊繃的離婚婆婆媳婦與小姑，命運交織地被迫同住在一個屋簷下撕下以往的對立標籤，三個性格迥異傷痕累累的女人在滿是摩擦與衝突的日常中，漸漸看清彼此的脆弱她們相互扶持攜手抵禦人生的逆境風浪，最終走出陰霾，共築出比血緣更堅固的暖心情誼！

programme.title: 兩個女人的房間
programme.desc: 慘遭閨蜜心機暗算 朴恩惠由飯店繼承人淪為女僕在瑞士留學歸來後，晴彩充滿自信地踏入了蒙娜麗莎飯店，端莊秀麗的外表和聰穎的頭腦，讓她很快成為了飯店的副社長兼繼承人與同飯店的總經理志燮之間的戀情，更是讓她的生活充滿了甜蜜和期待一場車禍意外將掀起腥風血雨，當晴彩以為自己撞死了熙秀的養父時，內心充滿了恐懼與內疚感，在晴彩的堅持下，熙秀搬進了她的家，開始了新的生活從那時起，晴彩心愛的人和她的一切都逐漸被熙秀所奪走，包括飯店的地位和財富，晴彩更是從繼承人淪為女僕，為了奪回曾經的一切，晴彩將對熙秀展開復仇

programme.title: 殘酷的實習生
programme.desc: 羅美蘭化身高年級實習生 道盡女性職場家庭壓力曾叱吒職場的女強人高海羅，在為家庭中斷事業七年後，決心重返職場找回自我價，從主管跌回實習生，她不僅要面對年齡與職場現實的殘酷挑戰，更得直面昔日競爭對手如今成為上司的崔智媛在一項充滿道德兩難的任務中，海羅被迫於同為母親的立場與職涯機會之間掙扎劇情深刻刻畫中年女性在家庭工作與自我之間的拉扯與重生，以真實而細膩的情感，引發無數職場女性共鳴

programme.title: 寵妻明君：李祘
programme.desc: 年幼的李祘目睹了父親死於政治陰謀，又在祖父近乎慘酷的調教下長大，雖然貴為王位繼承人，但政敵始終欲治李祘於死地，這些練就了李祘逆境中處變不驚不折不撓的品性宮廷畫苑的畫師韓松淵是李祘的紅粉知己後來松淵做了李祘的王妃，一直堅定地支持着李祘的治國大業

programme.title: 女王之家
programme.desc: 心機渣男出軌妻子閨蜜 為奪下豪門不擇手段！人人稱羨的模範夫妻申明燮與韓善珠，在紀念婚禮當天揭開了幸福假象出身豪門的善珠外表完美，內心卻藏著被背叛的恐懼；出身貧寒的明燮，靠婚姻翻轉人生卻陷入外遇泥沼而第三者尹美羅，不僅成為他的靈魂寄託，更在命運的捉弄下與善珠結為好友當真相逐步揭開，愛與恨正宮與小三的界線逐漸模糊，一場婚禮，也預告了一場悲劇的開始

programme.title: 當你沉睡時
programme.desc: 擁有預知夢能力的洪珠，因總是只能夢見未來卻無力改變而讓她痛苦不是金湯匙出生也沒有優秀的學歷及人脈，卻總是富有充滿正義感的檢察官宰璨兩人的相遇為了阻止夢境的可怕事件變成現實，開始相信對方是否能成為扭轉未來的人呢?

programme.desc: 擁有預知夢能力的洪珠，因總是只能夢見未來卻無力改變而讓她痛苦不是金湯匙出生也沒有優秀的學歷及人脈，卻總是富有充滿正義感的檢察官宰璨兩人的相遇為了阻止夢境的可怕事件變成現實，開始相信對方是否能成為扭轉未來的人呢?

programme.title: 兩個女人的房間
programme.desc: 慘遭閨蜜心機暗算 朴恩惠由飯店繼承人淪為女僕在瑞士留學歸來後，晴彩充滿自信地踏入了蒙娜麗莎飯店，端莊秀麗的外表和聰穎的頭腦，讓她很快成為了飯店的副社長兼繼承人與同飯店的總經理志燮之間的戀情，更是讓她的生活充滿了甜蜜和期待一場車禍意外將掀起腥風血雨，當晴彩以為自己撞死了熙秀的養父時，內心充滿了恐懼與內疚感，在晴彩的堅持下，熙秀搬進了她的家，開始了新的生活從那時起，晴彩心愛的人和她的一切都逐漸被熙秀所奪走，包括飯店的地位和財富，晴彩更是從繼承人淪為女僕，為了奪回曾經的一切，晴彩將對熙秀展開復仇

programme.title: 寵妻明君：李祘
programme.desc: 年幼的李祘目睹了父親死於政治陰謀，又在祖父近乎慘酷的調教下長大，雖然貴為王位繼承人，但政敵始終欲治李祘於死地，這些練就了李祘逆境中處變不驚不折不撓的品性宮廷畫苑的畫師韓松淵是李祘的紅粉知己後來松淵做了李祘的王妃，一直堅定地支持着李祘的治國大業

programme.title: 神槍手與咖喱雞粵普

programme.title: 喜歡妳是妳粵普

programme.title: 俠骨仁心粵普
programme.desc: Paul 的女友Jackie 曾經自殺,腦部受創,昏迷未醒.一日,Jackie 奇跡地醒來,她對過去的生活態度感到後悔,然而仍未能接受Paul 的感情.Jackie 到Paul 的好友兼腦科醫生Lawrence 家暫住,兩人相處日久,不知不覺間有著一份難以言喻的感情...

programme.title: 人皮燈籠粵普
programme.desc: 青年麥輝得古董錶引指,進入一破落的舊樓中,竟有舊地重臨之感,並帶出三十年前一段哀怨纏綿的絕世戀情 - 輝與蓉本為一對戀人,黑邦頭子雄爺對蓉唾涎,逼蓉獻身以供淫虐,輝拼命救蓉,反遭雄亂刀殺死...

programme.title: 奇蹟粵

programme.title: 打工狂想曲粵普
programme.desc: Becky, Angie, Candy是典型白領儷人.一日,Angie在公司發現一大袋金牛,後三人將錢運走.原來該款是經理大維,貪污被人勒索的掩口費.唐著令保安經理Albert查出真相,事情發展出人意表,結局又是另一驚訝意外...

programme.title: 大武當粵普
programme.desc: 初期,相傳武當山有稀世寶藏,百年輪回一次的武林盛會即將開戰,各路高手齊聚道教聖地武當山爭當天下第一. 民國,神秘女子使絕招搶奪大會戰貼加入戰局,表面上以武會友,背裡卻為一樁家族使命,而考古教授帶著自幼習武的女兒,為傳說中的鎮山之寶混入武當...

programme.title: 黑白戰場粵普
programme.desc: 米探長告訴四哥有人要暗殺他,因他雖然巳半退休,但仍掌管幫會的數億公家錢.他的手下棺材,炸彈和辛尼各懷鬼胎,各自想吞併這筆巨款.四哥立刻命自己幾年前在元朗由柴叔秘密培養的御林軍:發仔,花灑,大牛及二牛暗中保護自己.忠心之士與叛徒之戰立即展開,棺材和炸彈逐一被殺,人人自危,陰謀滿佈...

programme.title: PTU粵普

The film reveals new science about the dynamics of emperor penguin behaviour. In the north, unique aerial images show a polar bear swimming more than 100km. Diving for up to two minutes at a time. The exhausted polar bear later attacks a herd of walrus in a true clash of the titans.

programme.title: Gordon Buchanan: My Epic Camel Adventure S01
programme.desc: Gordon Buchanan takes an epic camel ride across the Gobi Desert to discover how these most iconic, yet least understood, animals have adapted to survive in extreme environments.

programme.title: Granada
programme.desc: Michael Portillo travels the Spanish region of Andalucia, meeting local people who share their passions. In Granada, he meets a food writer and tries his hand at a potters wheel.

programme.title: Series 6
programme.desc: A historic flood wipes out Valencia, Oregons third largest wildfire, and the deadliest hurricane to hit U.S. in almost 20 years.

programme.title: Michelle Rodriguez
programme.desc: Actress Michelle Rodriguez and Bear Grylls head to the Nevada. Unexpected high winds during a sky-diving trip send Michelle off course finally the duo must come up with clever ways to stay hydrated.

programme.title: Saving Asia
programme.desc: Remarkable people are dedicating their lives to saving Asias extraordinary wildlife using ingenious solutions. In Borneo, we follow a sun bear being released back into the wild, and in Java we see how a breeding programme is saving the Javan green magpie. In Japan, orphaned shark embryos are being raised in an artificial uterus. And off Bali, fishermen are trialling new technology that could stop rare species being caught in their nets. We witness a Nepali police raid disrupting the illegal wil

programme.title: Hippo Watch with Steve Backshall S01
programme.desc: Having learnt where a hippos aggression comes from Steve wants to find out if we can live alongside the animal that kills up to 500 people a year. He visits St.Lucia, a town where hippos roam the streets freely at night, feeding on the manicured lawns and bushes of the townsfolk. In order to see them out of the water he must come back at night.

programme.title: James Marsden
programme.desc: X-man James Marsden joins Bear on an adventure into the heart of Rattle Snake Canyon in Utah, where they helicopter on to one of the highest arches in the area.

programme.title: Island of Giants
programme.desc: The tale of one of the largest dinosaurs ever to walk the earth, a colossal, long-necked Lusotitan. Living 150 million years ago on an island known as the Iberian Mesta, now in Portugal, this 25-metre-long titan dwarfs every other dinosaur in the region. Yet his intimidating size is only part of the story. His ultimate goal is to win over a female and secure his legacy. Its a quest that will see him embark on an epic journey as he risks his life for love.

programme.title: Sue Perkins Into Alaska S01
programme.desc: Sue continues her Alaskan adventure of a lifetime, following the old gold trail route into the interior of Americas largest and wildest state. She heads off the beaten track to explore the states rich history and meet the incredible people who live in the Alaskan wilderness, to discover if she too could survive in its beautiful backcountry.

Wu successfully escapes to find the Gan family for help, not knowing that he is sending them into an ambush by the kidnappers. Can he finally save Lian Zhu?

programme.desc: A corrupt magistrate, obsessed with finding a hidden treasure, jails and tortures his daughters lover and buries his daughter alive! Ironically, it is in her coffin that the secret to the hidden treasure is found, setting off a frenzy of destruction.

The manor harbours notorious martial arts criminals and is rumoured to be haunted. Soon, during his investigation, Chu becomes entangled in a series of mysterious and eerie events.

programme.title: Hex Vs Witchcraft
programme.desc: A compulsive gambler with bad luck owes money to a violent gangster boss and trades his wife as down payment, causing her to leave him. As he decides to kill himself, a mysterious old man offers him a proposal to marry the ghost of his dead daughter in exchange for cash and an expensive apartment.

programme.title: Ambitious Kung Fu Girl
programme.desc: Si Si, a spoiled and naive rich girl with only basic kung fu training, becomes enchanted by the legends of the fearless hero Qin Ge. Determined to escape her fathers arranged marriage, she disguises herself as a man and sets out to find him, hoping to challenge Qin Ge-only to be drawn into a deadly plot within the criminal underworld.

programme.title: Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers?
programme.desc: Jenny Hu, Shaw Brothers gorgeous Chinese-German star, was given her first comedy role in the wild and wacky Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers? Described as a comedy of belly laughs and chilling murders, it is a unique entry in the Hong Kong theater of the absurd.

programme.title: Return of the One-armed Swordsman
programme.desc: One-armed Swordsman Fang Kang wants to lead a quiet life with his wife, but when she is abducted by the Eight Demon Swordsmen clan, he is forced to take them on in order to save her.

programme.title: Spring Blossoms
programme.desc: Some of Shaw Brothers biggest female stars of the 1970s share the screen in this tale of young love and interfering parents, starring Lily Li, Shu Pei Pei and Essie Lin Chia.

programme.title: Gang Master
programme.desc: This is a story about an army out to destroy the Hsien Lung gang of anti-Yuan revolutionaries. Their leader Ru Yi Tu is up against Fu Zhong Yuan, the identified successor of the Hsien Lung gang who must also prove his own legitimacy. The plot thickens with murder, sibling rivalry and shocking discoveries that could change the course of history.

programme.title: The Flag of Iron
programme.desc: When super director Chang Cheh found new talent and blood with The Five Venoms actors, most of which were trained in the highly acrobatic Chinese opera and well versed with exotic martial arts weapons, this created a new spark for his use of bizarre weapons in his films. The Flag Of Iron is one of 20 movies that he directed featuring the utterly flabbergasting and physically exhausting action bits created by these five dudes. You have the good guys from the righteous clan versus the bad guys f

programme.title: Operation Lipstick
programme.desc: A professors assistant stole a micro-film storing the secret of a newly invented nuclear reactor and sells it to a crime syndicate. However, the micro-film accidentally falls into the hands of a nightclub dancer and a thief in the process, leading to them being relentlessly pursued by the crime syndicate to retrieve the micro-film.

programme.title: Legendary Weapons of China
programme.desc: Lei Kung, the leader of the Boxer Clan in Yunnan, dissolves the clan to save his disciples before going into self-exile. The Clan sends various assassins to kill him but failed. They then assigned Kungs brother Yong to find and kill Kung, leading to a battle between the two brothers.

programme.title: Pale Passion
programme.desc: Fa is an obsessive man who loves his wife Ah Hsia but is easily jealous and abuses her. When she leaves him one day, Fa hooks up with another woman, Hsing. A deadly triangle develops when Fa runs into Ah Hsia again and decides to win her back...

programme.title: Five Superfighters
programme.desc: A kung fu master and his three students lost everything after they are floored by a bully. To take revenge, the students find ways to learn from other kung fu masters and come back six months later to have a rematch with the bully on their masters birthday.

programme.title: Song Of Orchid Island
programme.desc: Dr. He moves to the remote Lanyu island off the coast of Taiwan to look for his long lost father, and starts to run a clinic curing islanders who are bitten by the fatal red worms there. He meets Ya Lan who works as a nurse in his clinic and falls in love with him. Things get vicious for Dr. He as a jealous islander plots to get rid of him...

programme.title: Shaolin Mantis
programme.desc: The Emperor orders Feng to find proofs of Master Tians rebellion in his house. Feng falls in love with Tians granddaughter and marries her. When he finds the proofs and tries to leave with her, his wife is killed in the fight against Tian. Feng creates the mantis-style martial arts and vows to avenge her death.

programme.title: River of Tears
programme.desc: Retired singer Fang lives happily with her husband and son. Tragedy happens when a man from her past returns to haunt her. In an ensuing struggle to free her from his clutches, her husband dies in a car accident. Blamed by her father-in-law for her husbands death, Fang gets chased out of the house and goes back to singing to make a living...

programme.title: Heroes of the East
programme.desc: A Chinese man marries a Japanese woman through an arranged marriage and manages to insult all of her Japanese martial arts family by issuing a challenge to her that is misinterpreted by the others. He must then prove how good Chinese Kung Fu really is through a series of duels with the seven Japanese martial artists who come to meet the challenge!

programme.title: Forever And Ever
programme.desc: Ivy Ling Po plays a young scholar who is manipulated into marrying a noblemans reluctant daughter. After marrying, he soon discovers the reason for her hesitation. She is stricken with a contagious disease. But, with the power of true love, their romance prevails.

programme.title: The Magnificent Trio
programme.desc: A group of farmers who are being oppressed by the local magistrates kidnap one of the magistrates daughter in the hope of being heard by the authorities. A wandering swordsman offers his help and aiding him are two fighters who have both switched sides from being the oppressors to the oppressed. The trio fight back against the magistrates!

programme.title: The Human Goddess
programme.desc: Seventh Sister, a curious fairy from heaven, descends to 1970s Hong Kong. Lost in an unfamiliar world, she is rescued by Tung Chi Lap, who runs a debt-ridden orphanage. When a tycoon plots to seize the land, she uses her powers to protect it, and an unlikely romance begins.

programme.title: Raw Courage
programme.desc: After the Ming Emperor is overthrown and his infant son was put in the care of the Black Dragon Society, a traitorous martial arts clan attacks the society, forcing an inexperienced pair of swordsman and swordswoman to flee with the infant. Their journey to deliver the infant to safety is filled with dangers that would require help from other allies...

programme.title: King Of Beggars
programme.desc: So was born a nobleman but is relegated to a beggar after being caught cheating. He becomes the chief of the Beggars gang when he saves the gangs elder. One day, So foils an assassination attempt on the Emperor and is allowed to reinstate his status but he declines. He is then rewarded with an imperial beggar bowl and lives happily ever after.

programme.title: Never Leave
programme.desc: Strange incidents keep happening in Lin Yues house after a car accident: her sister cannot see the images of her family members in the mirror her father is peeping at night and there is the sound of marbles from the attic every day at dawn. Following the sound to the attic, Lin Yue finds her own death portrait as she opens the door...

programme.title: The Grey Men
programme.desc: Hong Kong police officer Ah Shan goes undercover in prison to gain the trust of criminal Tian and seek evidence against his gang. After their release, Shan helps Tian rise within the gang and become the new boss. However, as Shan cracks down on the gang, he uncovers a shocking secret about Tian...

programme.title: Cop Shop Babes
programme.desc: Island East Police Station headed by Madam Lui is known for its Cop Shop Babes as all the officers there are female. Two police officers, Beer and Satay, apply for an internal transfer to this station in order to approach the girls. It is at this time that the police receives a bomb threat can they resolve the case?

programme.title: Dragon Master: Dragon Spell
programme.desc: The Dragon King is locked in a seal by the Dragon Master for 500 years, and his daughter must travel back in time to 500 years ago to kill the Dragon Master, in order to reverse the act. Little did she know that the Dragon King and Dragon Master were close friends back then

programme.title: The Bare-footed Kid
programme.desc: A poor, bare-footed young man from the countryside arrives in the city to work with the friend of his dead father. When their dye shop is burnt down by a local strongman, he decides to fight back to protect all of them and save the shop.

programme.title: Lets Have a Baby
programme.desc: De Sheng and Wan Jun have been married for years, but are unable to conceive. Wan Jun decides to undergo artificial insemination in the States and finally gets pregnant. She meets her cousin from the States who stays temporarily in their house with them, and De Sheng begins to suspect that they are having an affair

programme.title: Casino Tycoon
programme.desc: Inspired by the story of Macaus Casino King Stanley Ho, the movie traces his blood-splattered fight to the top from 1930s to 1960s. In 1941, a young graduate, Benny Ho, flees Hong Kong during the Japanese invasion and heads for Macau. Benny starts as a labourer but rises to the top of the citys casino business with his courage, wisdom and diligence.

programme.title: From Beijing With Love
programme.desc: A reactivated backup Chinese agent, posing as a butcher, is unexpectedly assigned to recover a stolen dinosaur skull. Sent to Hong Kong, he is aided by a female agent who is secretly working for the villains. Together, they navigate betrayals and confront the mastermind, ultimately recovering the national treasure and exposing the conspiracy.

programme.title: Mr Vampire III
programme.desc: Taoist conman Ming fails to banish vengeful spirits and escapes with his ghostly companions. As they seek refuge in a village, they encounter an evil witch whose goal is to eliminate the human race. Ming then allies with Taoist priest Master Jiu to battle the witchbut can they prevail against such overwhelming darkness?

programme.title: Love in a Fallen City
programme.desc: Based on a novel of the same name by the famous novelist Eileen Chang and directed by the equally acclaimed director Ann Hui, this romance story depicts the challenging relationship between an introverted Shanghai divorcee and a cynical Malaysian playboy during the Japanese invasion of Hong Kong in the 1940s. Will the lovers be together in the end?

programme.title: The Monkey is Back
programme.desc: The legendary Stone Monkey gives hope to a desperate girl by promising to change her fate. Years later, after a fierce battle against the powerful three-eyed God of War, he is defeated and cast into the mortal world. Stripped of his former glory, Stone Monkey must rise again, confront powerful enemies, and fulfil the promise he once made.

programme.title: Lost Memories
programme.desc: As a young mother grapples with her daughters mysterious disappearance, a series of eerie events unfold. These events could be linked to the vengeful ghosts of a tragic accident that happened 20 years ago...

programme.title: Jealousy
programme.desc: Model Min dies mysteriously in a hospital rumoured to be haunted. Soon after, her photographer receives eerie phone calls, a writer suffers a bizarre car accident, and Mins friend suddenly vanishes. As fear spreads, dark secrets and supernatural forces emerge, drawing them into a terrifying nightmare linked to Mins death.

programme.title: Blind War
programme.desc: Former SWAT captain Dong Gu suffers traumatic visual loss during a failed mission for which he is forced to take responsibility. He manages to get over and adapt to the situation with his daughters company, until his nemesis appears and puts his daughter in danger. Despite being blind, Dong Gu must fight to save his daughter.

programme.title: The Flying Mr. B
programme.desc: Mr. Shi, a secondary PE teacher, accidentally takes a super pill invented by the science teacher and gains superpower, turning into Mr. B. He uses his superpower to help the school sports team win the championship and prevent crimes. When the triad is made aware of Mr. Bs superpower, they try to gain the super pill for nefarious purposes.

programme.title: Fight Back to School III
programme.desc: When millionaire Wong is found murdered in a hotel room, Sing, who bears a striking resemblance to the victim, goes undercover as the deceased to investigate the case. With Wongs marriage already on the rocks, his wife becomes the prime suspect. However, Sing soon uncovers that Wongs close friend is suspicious as well...

programme.title: Unbeatable
programme.desc: Former world champion boxer Fai meets fiery young fighter Qi in Macau. As he mentors Qi for an upcoming MMA tournament, Fai rekindles his passion for fighting, life, and the people he cares about.

programme.title: Legend Of The Dragon
programme.desc: A young man Lung leaves his rural home on a small island to seek fortune in Hong Kong. His uncle cons Lung to play in a snooker tournament using his fathers land as the bet. Lung lost the match but luckily, his childhood friend Momo encourages him to compete again using her land as the bet. Can he finally win his land back?

programme.title: The Great Magician
programme.desc: Warlord Lui Dai Ngau commands a powerful army but fails to win the heart of Lau Yiu, whom he keeps in his mansion against her will. Meanwhile, renowned magician Cheung Yin arrives to perform for Lui, while secretly plotting to rescue Lau Yiu and avenge the tragedy that destroyed his family years ago.

programme.title: The Comeback
programme.desc: Uncle Hua is a retired agent who owns an antique shop on an old street. When the old street is forcibly demolished by the local Green Dragon Gang one day, Uncle Huas hidden identity is accidentally revealed, and he is pursued by a mysterious organization headed by Ah Jie. A fatal duel has just begun!

programme.title: Painted Faces
programme.desc: This is based on the real-life story of Master Yu Jim Yuen who strives to run his academy in the 1960s, even as the opera culture is declining. Three young men, Sammo Hung, Jackie Chan and Yuen Biao, are determined to train under Master Yu and undergo extremely tough training before they become three of Hong Kongs biggest stars

programme.title: Final Justice 1988
programme.desc: Chang is a brilliant police inspector, but his maverick ways have put him at odds with both his superiors and peers. When he encounters Wai, a streetwise car thief who accidentally becomes the key to tracking down a gang of armed bank robbers, the two form an uneasy alliance to bring the criminals to justice.

programme.desc: The core rolling news service of CGTN, with regular updates from Beijing, Washington, Nairobi and London, keep viewers up-to-date with all the worlds top stories as they happen. The World Today delivers breaking news, live events, in-depth reporting, expert analysis and sustained coverage.

programme.desc: The dollhouse delivery is a cat-in-the-box that startles Gabby, giving her the hiccups. Dr. Pandy and the Gabby Cats try several cures, but it isnt until CatRat scares the hiccups out of Gabby that they go away!

programme.title: Hamster Kitties
programme.desc: When 6 adorable hamster kitties get loose in the dollhouse, Gabby, Pandy and Baby Box head out to look for them. Along the way, Baby Box learns a lot about hamster kitties, which convinces Mama Box to let them live in the Craft Room.

programme.title: Tea Times Up Barks, Baths, and Beyond
programme.desc: When Athena thinks Lola no longer wants to have their weekly tea party, a tradition theyve had as long as Athena can remember, Athena tries everything she can to get Lola to have another one. When Tracy and Harper accidentally leave Wilford at home, on their way to the Fairhaven Pet Get Together, its up to the Dew Drops to get him to the park on time. But because it just rained, getting Wilford there clean proves to be a challenge.

programme.title: The Secret Ingredient Delete That Dew!
programme.desc: When Harper is missing an ingredient to make her Moms favorite dessert on Mothers Day, Eden enlists the help of her fellow Dew Drops to do an emergency city-wide ingredient search! When Marcus records a video of his inventions, Phoebe gets caught on camera and must erase the footage before Marcus sees, or her Dew Drop cover will be blown!

programme.title: Berry Race The Artist
programme.desc: The kids have a race to decide who gets to try some extremely rare berries. When Scallop finds a beautiful and mysterious sea sculpture, she enlists the help of her friends to search the sea for the artist behind the masterpiece.

programme.title: Winkly Fest Snow
programme.desc: When Pixie struggles to recreate an old tradition perfectly, the kids realize they can make their own traditions. A story told by Chef J inspires Juniper to go in search of snow.

programme.title: Happy Birthday Pawston
programme.desc: Tag and Scooch embark on a road trip to Chew York City to track down Kelly Korgi to ask her to perform at Pawstons 100th birthday party. When Kelly Korgi tells Tag she cant perform at Pawstons 100th birthday party, she and Scooch decide to create a Kelly Korgi replacement so that she doesnt break her promise to the town.

programme.title: Big Dog Job The Case of the Slobbery
programme.desc: Tag tries to prove to Mom that shes a big dog by puppysitting Yip and Rhonda all day. All she has to do is get them to the playground, but the pups keep running off. When a giant, bone-shaped, roller coaster ride goes missing from the Amusement Bark, Detectives Tag and Scooch take on the case of the slobbery robbery.

programme.title: Grumblegard, Part 1
programme.desc: While the others care for baby dragons at the roost, Dak, Winger, Burple and Aggro come face-to-face with a grumpy old dragon on a dangerous island.

programme.title: Grumblegard, Part 2
programme.desc: The Rescue Riders plan to team up with the Slinkwings when an angry Grumblegard threatens Huttsgalor. But their old enemies may be up to new tricks.

programme.title: A Tadpole Tale
programme.desc: When fun-loving, water-dwelling tadpole LALA shows up in Glorias tank, the two become underwater besties! But when Molly wants Gloria to spend Palentines Day with her, Gloria cant admit shes already made plans to spend it with her land friends and runs herself ragged running back and forth between Molly and the gang. Glorias attempts to make everyone happy backfire, leading her to learn that she can have different groups of friends, and its okay to play with them one at a time, or all

programme.title: Groundhog Day
programme.desc: Gloria wants spring to come! Shes SICK of winter and is counting down the days until the Central Park pond melts so she can retrieve a toy she lost in the water before it froze! So when Goldie the Groundhog predicts more winter, Gloria sets out to make spring come, by any means necessary! When she fails at controlling the weather, Gloria learns that when something doesnt go your way, embrace Plan B!

programme.title: Trolly Tales 2 Rainbowmageddon
programme.desc: The Trolls try to entertain and win over Archer Pastry with a series of Troll storiesWhen a rainbow over Troll Village begins to experience a catastrophic breakdown, Cloud Guy arrives in the village to offer his assistance

programme.title: Coop, Wheres My Guy? Fluffleberry Quest
programme.desc: When Cooper loses Guy Diamond in Troll Forest, Poppy and Branch accompany him as he retraces his steps Poppy sets out to recreate the recipe of Branchs favorite dessert at any cost

programme.title: A Family Friend
programme.desc: There is more epic action and intrigue as Po and the Dragon Knights continue their quest to destroy the Tianshang weapons, but find themselves in treacherous waters when they are captured by pirates, one of which is out for revenge against Mr. Ping! The adventures lead them to London, where they are wanted by the Knights. Old enemies resurface and Blade will have to face one of her most challenging opponentsher mom. And somehow, Po finds himself in a chess tournament against the Queen of Englan

programme.title: The English Opening
programme.desc: There is more epic action and intrigue as Po and the Dragon Knights continue their quest to destroy the Tianshang weapons, but find themselves in treacherous waters when they are captured by pirates, one of which is out for revenge against Mr. Ping! The adventures lead them to London, where they are wanted by the Knights. Old enemies resurface and Blade will have to face one of her most challenging opponentsher mom. And somehow, Po finds himself in a chess tournament against the Queen of Englan

programme.title: The Bog-ey Man of Festermouth
programme.desc: There is more epic action and intrigue as Po and the Dragon Knights continue their quest to destroy the Tianshang weapons, but find themselves in treacherous waters when they are captured by pirates, one of which is out for revenge against Mr. Ping! The adventures lead them to London, where they are wanted by the Knights. Old enemies resurface and Blade will have to face one of her most challenging opponentsher mom. And somehow, Po finds himself in a chess tournament against the Queen of Englan

programme.title: The Fugitives
programme.desc: Now that theyre officially on the run, the team heads down to Mexico City to hide out in one of Ms. Nowheres many safe houses. With super-agent Palindrome and the police hot on their tales, they decide the only way theyre going to survive is by getting their hands on some money by winning an underground derby race.

programme.title: The Battles of Gongmen Bay
programme.desc: Po and the Kids agree to escort a dirigible shipment of food to a drought-torn region of China. But Nu Hai has some suspicions about Shi Long, which she finds arent far off when she discovers the dirigible is set to explode...with them on board!

programme.title: Gongmen City Hustle
programme.desc: Po and the Kids make it to Gongmen City in search of the contact they heard has some info on the dirigible crash. Meanwhile, Xiao, mourning the presumed death of her new panda friends, takes off into the woods and meets a new friend.

programme.title: Greatest Classics Oscar De La Hoya vs. Mike Grable
programme.desc: This edition highlights a bout early in the career of The Golden Boy, fresh off his gold medal winning performance in the Olympic Games, as Oscar De La Hoya competes in just his 6th professional fight taking on 13-1-2 Mike Grable. De La Hoya had knocked out his first five opponents to start his illustrious career, and had his sights set on a World Championship less than two years after his debut. First, he would have to get passed Grable of Clarkston, Michigan, hoping for a historic upset.

Also on the card, a heavyweight kickboxing clash between Errol Zimmerman vs. Rico Verhoeven.

programme.title: Wide World of Fights Jonathon Banks vs. Seth Mitchell
programme.desc: Wide World Of Fights includes all styles of fighting from around the world in one show! This episode features a heavyweight battle that ends in a curious decision between Jonathon Banks and Seth Mitchell , as well as kickboxing, sumo, arm wrestling and more!

programme.title: Budpaest 2023 - Episode 2
programme.desc: The highest level of competition in the sport of karate anywhere in the world will take place from Budapest, Hungary, as the WKF SENIOR WORLD CHAMPIONSHIPS take place. The top competitors from across the globe, from six different continents, will all converge on Budapest to stake their claim as the best in the world. Dont miss the WKF SENIOR WORLD CHAMPIONSHIPS, only on FIGHT SPORTS.

programme.title: KNOCKOUTS! Juan Manuel Marquez vs. Juan Diaz
programme.desc: The main event in this episode is Juan Manuel Marquez vs. Juan Diaz with three lightweight titles on the line. This fight earned Fight of the Year honors from The Ring magazine. Also on the card, heavyweight kickboxing action.

programme.title: Tokyo, Japan Episode 5
programme.desc: For the first time the top ranked sumo competitors in the world are featured in an action packed series, FIGHT SPORTS GRAND SUMO. This new format presents Sumo in an authentic, in-depth and entertaining way covering the rules, ranks, match-ups, and more. Episode 5 from Tokyo, Japan at the Ryogoku Kokugikan, features Kiribayama, Terunofuji, Mitakeumi and Daieisho.

programme.title: Pariah: Sonny Liston
programme.desc: Was Sonny Liston murdered? This four-part documentary series explores the life and untimely death of boxing legend Charles Sonny Liston, who became the heavyweight champion of the world when he knocked out Floyd Patterson in 1962. Unfortunately, just eight years later, he was found dead in his Las Vegas home from an alleged heroin overdose. Suspicion regarding the real cause of his death has continued to this day. Episode 1 of 4.

programme.title: 正义女神Themis
programme.desc: 言惠知因一宗少年案放弃晋升高院机会，转任少年法庭裁判官，也因此与丈夫离婚她坚持不枉不纵，在惩罚与救赎之间守护公义，赢得法院上下敬重立志成为最年轻高院法官的郑邵文因她的到来仕途受阻面对连串少年罪案，两人在理念碰撞中，携手帮助迷途少年重返正轨After a life-changing juvenile crime case, Zhi leaves a fast-track High Court career for the Juvenile Court, costing her marriage. As she and ambitious magistrate Wen tackle difficult youth cases, they balance justice, compassion and redemption.

programme.title: 百味人生Bittersweet Destiny
programme.desc: 百味人生是一部以料理为引线，交织情感人性与台湾文化的原创戏剧故事围绕一位总舖师因为一宗陷害事件，使其女儿与五位徒弟从分崩离析到彼此纠葛，呈现横跨25年的恩怨情仇与家族纠结剧中每一段故事，都对应一道人生滋味，展现爱情的甜亲情的苦背叛的辣梦想的酸与欲望的咸，融合台湾人饮食文化与庶民记忆，勾勒出在生命里最熟悉的味道与情感，透过时代转变与两代间的冲突，诉说成长与和解的历程，是一部结合文化深度与情感张力的戏剧Bittersweet Destiny is a Taiwanese original series that uses cuisine as the connecting thread to weave together themes of emotion, human nature, and Taiwanese culture. The story is sparked by a frame-up incident involving a master chef, which causes his daughter and five apprentices to ...

programme.title: 型男大主厨Stylish Man
programme.desc: 台湾广受欢迎的常青美食料理节目，由2006年始播至今，2011年还获选金钟奖的最佳综合节目主持人奖每一期将有不同的主题：大明星來下廚由兩位明星或两个明星档分組對抗，拿出自己的拿手菜對抗比拼；五分钟出好菜由两位厨师根据指定食材，在五分钟内烹煮出易学美味的一道菜等这是一个富有娱乐效果的轻松美食节目，能够持续制作这么多年不是没有理由的

programme.title: 爱的荣耀Glory of Love
programme.desc: 一桩吸金诈骗案意外改变了三个女人的命运：有如大树般坚强的女性；如花般绽放的富家千金；也有如小草般的平凡女性借由三个女主角来传达自信勇气及自我价值的重要性，从爱出发能克服任何困境挖掘出无限潜能和力量！A money-driven fraud case unexpectedly alters the destinies of three women: a resilient woman resembling a sturdy tree, a wealthy daughter blossoming like a flower, and an ordinary woman akin to grass. These three heroines convey the message of self-worth, highlighting the importance of love in overcoming challenges and unlocking ones unlimited potential.

programme.title: 阿松与阿暖Our Town, Her Time
programme.desc: 台湾小镇纸艺师阿松性格固执，与家人关系紧张，人生陷入了停滞某天，来自明朝的神秘女子阿暖突然出现成为他的徒弟，打破了他的平静生活一段相处后，两人发现彼此有跨越三百年的命运牵连在阿暖的影响下，阿松逐渐改变，学会面对情感与家庭，也与她产生了深刻连结故事融合了传统文化奇幻与成长，是一段关于改变与归属的温暖旅程Song, a stubborn paper artisan in a small town, leads a stagnant life until Nuan, a mysterious woman from the Ming Dynasty, appears as his apprentice. As they uncover a bond spanning 300 years, Song learns to embrace love, mend family ties, and discover where he truly belongs.

programme.title: Wild Science Season 1
programme.desc: Trace the lions rise from prehistoric predator to modern ruler as science reveals the battles, bonds, and brutal survival strategies that have shaped this iconic African hunter. Get swept up in the drama of lion society and high-risk hunts.

programme.title: Woodpeckers: The Hole Story
programme.desc: March to the steady drumbeat of a unique avian family. Learn why the worlds 239 woodpecker species, from massive to minute, are natures best lumberjacks explore their flying, climbing, and calling skills and get a look inside their secret nests.

programme.title: Loons: A Cry from the Mist
programme.desc: Race the clock with biologists as they try to figure out why North American loons are suddenly in danger. Unlock the mysterious lives of these beloved birds, and ponder whether their cries will continue to be summers soundtrack or go silent forever.

programme.title: Super Shark Highway Season 1
programme.desc: Stay up late as the northern team attaches an activity tag to a bull shark and finds out what this night owl does after sunset. Then dive 80 meters deep with the southern team, who are hoping to put a satellite tracker on a female great white.

programme.title: Rooted Season 1
programme.desc: This is the incredible story of a tree that has been around for eight hundred years that can withstand the harshest conditions and that is more loved by insects, birds and animals than any otherthe enormous Baobab. Rooted on the savannah of Malilangwe Game Reserve in southern Zimbabwe.

programme.title: Superbeast Season 1
programme.desc: Experience animal abilities that are beyond human reach. See how saltwater crocodiles detect the tiniest movement with their pressure-sensitive domes, discover a pigeons internal GPS system, and use a seventh sense to detect prey with dolphins.

programme.title: Superbeast Season 1
programme.desc: Deploy biochemical weaponry with natures most cunning and resilient fighters. Unleash venomous bites with Komodo dragons, resist poisonous foes with mongoose mobs, and see birds use bone-crushing force to counter poisonous attacks.

programme.title: Wild Latin America Season 1
programme.desc: Get to know South Americas only bear species. Witness the shy and charismatic spectacled bear play, forage, and look for mates at the secluded Chaparri Ecological Reserve in Northern Peru.

programme.title: 阿龙Atonement
programme.desc: 单亲爸爸阿龙与女儿相依为命，生活清贫却始终相信好人有好报然而一次泰国之旅，女儿惨遭拐走，令他的信念彻底崩塌为了寻回女儿，他不惜铤而走险，与当地华侨再婚，只为留在异国追查拐卖集团，在复仇与救赎之间，最终化身双手沾血的复仇者

programme.title: 热辣滚烫YOLO
programme.desc: 乐莹感到迷失和无所事事，在短暂的工作经历后，她选择退出社会某天，经历了一连串意外事件后，她决定全新开始，拥抱生活的可能性当她遇见一位拳击教练时，心中燃起了对新生活的希望然而，随之而来的挑战却超出了她的想象，开启了她热血沸腾的人生旅程

programme.title: 有只僵尸暗恋你The Vampire who admires me
programme.desc: 新青春服装品牌的老板King少，带同怪鸡导演Roman，在模特儿经理人率领下，与一群美少女模特儿Macy，台湾小天后性感教主Chelsea，BiBi，Apple Susie等，来到阴气极强的东龙岛上，大拍性感泳衣造型照及开派对岛上四处埋有僵尸，众美女模特儿却不知危险，更为争夺岛上钻石王老五King少而大斗法，直到挂起八号风球，岛上交通断絶，此时僵尸出土狂咬居民，美少女陷入险境，在岛上孤立无援...

programme.title: 鹦鹉杀Tainted Love
programme.desc: 都市白领周冉在一次网恋中，被骗走了55万循着骗子留下的蛛丝马迹，周冉来到沿海小城，并意外结识了两名青年周冉渐渐发现二人身上隐藏着自己受骗的线索，一场复仇之计也由此展开.

programme.title: 叶问：终极一战Ip Man- The Final Fight
programme.desc: 电影把这位一代宗师叶问晚年在香港的生活如实呈现包括叶问不顾徒弟的反对，在妻子死后与红颜知己歌女的一段缘，与长子叶准之间亦师亦父的父子情，及与晋身成国际武打巨星的徒弟李小龙的重遇等

programme.title: 出租家人We are Family
programme.desc: 沉迷于演戏的临时演员志光，加入由家聪与立志成为女演员的佩怡一起成立的出租家人公司，变成出租临时家人当他们出演临时家人服务时，发现家庭成员间的复杂关系，并建立更深入的联系

programme.title: 红毯先生The Movie Emperor
programme.desc: 刘伟驰是一位渴望赢得电影奖项的香港天王巨星他与导演林浩合作拍摄以中国农村为题材的影片，希望在国际电影节能赢得荣誉于是，刘伟驰为农夫的角色体验当地乡村生活，结果却是笑话连篇的一场闹剧

programme.title: 冲天火Sky on Fire
programme.desc: 任职于顶尖秘密医疗设施的保安主任宗天保，在一名年轻窃贼盗取一种突破性新药后，卷入了一场激烈的争斗然而，当他揭开该药物的真正起源后，宗天保必须寻找可靠的盟友来保护这药物，确保它不落入歹徒之手，并阻止一场残酷的争夺战爆发

programme.title: 年少日记Time Still Turns the Pages
programme.desc: 一封没署名的遗书，让中学老师郑Sir想起充满暴力与遗憾的童年往事在找出企图轻生的同学，阻止悲剧重现的同时，他也需面对妻子要离婚和父亲病危的问题

programme.title: 狼群Wolf Pack
programme.desc: 老刁率领的狼群小队是一队长期在外国行事的雇佣兵，某次执行任务的过程中，意外发现一股恐怖势力企图炸毁国家能源命脉！老刁临危受命，率领队员出击危机迫在眉睫，狼群小队能否化险为夷？

programme.title: 正义女神Themis
programme.desc: 言惠知因一宗少年案放弃晋升高院机会，转任少年法庭裁判官，也因此与丈夫离婚她坚持不枉不纵，在惩罚与救赎之间守护公义，赢得法院上下敬重立志成为最年轻高院法官的郑邵文因她的到来仕途受阻面对连串少年罪案，两人在理念碰撞中，携手帮助迷途少年重返正轨After a life-changing juvenile crime case, Zhi leaves a fast-track High Court career for the Juvenile Court, costing her marriage. As she and ambitious magistrate Wen tackle difficult youth cases, they balance justice, compassion and redemption.

programme.title: 夏日奇妙书My Marvellous Fable
programme.desc: 实习编辑冯天蓝加入出版社的第一份任务就是去催畅销作家王葡萄的稿件，而她交稿的条件就是让冯天蓝从北京开车送她回老家琼海！在回乡的旅程中，王葡萄开始说一些真假参杂的故事，冯天蓝在整理书稿中拼凑出了王葡萄的人生，而王葡萄也在创作中反思自我两个心中有伤的人展开了互相治愈的浪漫奇幻之旅

programme.title: 爱情有烟火Love Has Fireworks
programme.desc: At Shanlifang, Qian Fei faces Wang Ruohai and Liao Shiyu, drunkenly blurting out evidence of financial fraud over lunch. Li Yifei shields her, and she chooses professionalism over old hurt.

programme.title: 阿松与阿暖Our Town, Her Time
programme.desc: 台湾小镇纸艺师阿松性格固执，与家人关系紧张，人生陷入了停滞某天，来自明朝的神秘女子阿暖突然出现成为他的徒弟，打破了他的平静生活一段相处后，两人发现彼此有跨越三百年的命运牵连在阿暖的影响下，阿松逐渐改变，学会面对情感与家庭，也与她产生了深刻连结故事融合了传统文化奇幻与成长，是一段关于改变与归属的温暖旅程Song, a stubborn paper artisan in a small town, leads a stagnant life until Nuan, a mysterious woman from the Ming Dynasty, appears as his apprentice. As they uncover a bond spanning 300 years, Song learns to embrace love, mend family ties, and discover where he truly belongs.

programme.title: 爱的荣耀Glory of Love

programme.title: Dulang Boy
programme.desc: Dulang Boy mengisahkan tentang seorang budak lelaki berusia 10 tahun bernama Kerol Lazania KL yang teruja kerana dipilih menjadi dulang boy untuk majlis perkahwinan kakaknya, Ros. Tugasnya adalah membawa dulang berisi sepasang kasut yang dianggap sangat Istimewa. Namun, pada pagi majlis perkahwinan, KL dan sahabat baiknya Yoyo mencuri masa untuk bergambar dengan kasut tersebut. Malangnya, KL terpijak lumpur lalu mengotorkan kasut tersebut. Mereka cuba mencuci kasut itu, tetapi akhirnya kasut tersebut koyak pula. KL dan Yoyo kemudian berusaha sedaya upaya untuk membetulkan keadaan sebelum majlis bermula.

programme.title: Isteri Dalam Sangkar
programme.desc: Aisyah merindui kampung halaman, dia bersendirian di dalam kondo. Iskandar langsung tidak menghiraukan Aisyah dan terus membiarkan Aisyah bergerak sendiri di dalam kondo. Perbezaan alatan yang canggih di kondo itu membuatkan Aisyah sering melakukan kesilapan dan membuatkan dia dimarahi oleh Iskandar. Aisyah membiarkan dirinya terus dimarahi, kepergian dan kepulangan Iskandar ke kondo itu tidak langsung membuatkan mereka berhubung. Namun, disebabkan Aisyah seorang gadis kampung yang cerdik dan rajin, dia tidak pernah berhenti menyediakan makanan untuk Iskandar, segala keperluan memasak di pesan oleh Aisyah kepada Haziq yang sering datang ke kondo untuk menghilangkan rasa sunyi Aisyah meskipun Iskandar turut berada di kondo mewah itu. Hidup Aisyah yang bagaikan seorang isteri di dalam sebuah sangkar mewah dilenyapkan rasa sakit itu dengan aktiviti yang disukainya iaitu memasak. Disebabkan hidangan makanan yang lazat dan cukup membuka selera itu membuatkan mata Iskandar dan Aisyah kerap kali bertentang. Sementara satu pertemuan sedang di atur oleh Tengku Maria untuk meneruskan hasratnya menyatukan Iskandar dan Tengku Waiduri.

programme.title: Sedingin Cinta Antasya
programme.desc: Syarfan merupkan pengurus besar di sebuah syarikat automotif milik keluarganya. Akibat tergesa-gesa ingin menghadiri mesyuarat penting Syarfan tergelincir ketika melalui lantai yang basah. Accident itu telah menjadi satu titik pertemuan diantara Syarfan dan Antasya seorang gadis cantik yang bekerja sebagai seorang cleaner di syarikatnya.

programme.title: Lelaki Melayu Terakhir
programme.desc: Qasih cuba meyakinkan Alawiyah supaya tidak menerima beliau sebagai menantu dengan meletakkan pelbagai syarat. Fatimah menghadiahkan sesuatu kepada Ustadz Jazlan dan menerima hadiah tasbih sebagai balasannya. Alawiyah dan Khatijah berjumpa dengan Habib untuk dapatkan doa-doa mustajab untuk melembutkan hati anak-anak mereka agar menerima cadangan untuk disatukan sebagai suami isteri

programme.title: Cinta Dalam Sekam

programme.title: Isteri Dalam Sangkar
programme.desc: Pertemuan yang dirancang dengan rapi antara Iskandar dan Tengku Waiduri membuatkan Iskandar semakin tertekan. Di pertemuan itu, Tengku Waiduri secara rahsia memberitahu Iskandar dia sudah mempunyai kekasih da meminta agar Iskandar menggagalkan rancangan Tengku Maria dalam apa jua keadaan, namun hal itu sukar dilakukan oleh Iskandar kerana jawatan CEO sedang menanti dirinya dan ditambah lagi dengan rahsia dia sudah mengahwini Aisyah. Entah kenapa malam itu, Iskandar rasa cukup tertekan, dia tidak tahu apa yang harus difikirkannya. Lalu Iskandar pergi berhibur bersama rakan-rakan dan pulang dalam keadaan mabuk. Aisyah memanjakan dirinya sendiri di kondo mewah itu setelah seharian melakukan kerja. Sebuah tab di ruangan bilik air menjadi pilihan Aisyah untuk memanjakan diri. Tidak sedar Iskandar sudah pulang dan keadaan Iskandar yang mabuk membawa kepada satu kejadian yang merentap mahkota Aisyah. Aisyah langsung tidak menyangka dirinya dirakus sebegitu oleh Iskandar namun dia redha kerana dia adalah seorang isteri, meskipun Aisyah sedar Iskandar tidak menyedari akan kelakuaannya ketika itu tetapi atas tanggungjawab seorang isteri dia harus membiarkan dirinya diperlakukan seperti itu. Aisyah lena di kamar Iskandar, di terkejut apabila Iskandar melemparkan wang di atas tubuhnya.

Syarfan terpaku.

programme.title: Lelaki Melayu Terakhir
programme.desc: Qasih dapati teman lelakinya Edy sedang bersembang mesra dengan kawan baiknya Diana. Jazlan mengajak keluarganya makan malam di sebuah restoran dan idea tersebut dipanjangkan Alawiyah kepada Khatijah untuk membawa Qasih makan bersama mereka. Apabila soalan diajukan kepada anak-anak mereka, Jazlan dan Qasih tidak mempunyai perasaan antara satu sama lain dan ianya amat merisaukan Alawiyah dan Khatijah.

programme.title: Cinta Dalam Sekam
programme.desc: Petunjuk baharu dalam pencarian Alia untuk menemukan Laila membawanya semakin hampir kepada kebenaran. Ketika kisah silam terbongkar, Shafiq berdepan persimpangan, manakala kehidupan dalam pelarian mendedahkan Imran dan Laila kepada niat tersembunyi serta bahaya baharu.

programme.desc: Rasya Aleeya hadir dalam satu majlis prom night. Rasya Aleeya berjalan sendirian dengan memakai dress hitam dengan rambut panjang dilepaskan. Rasya belum bersedia untuk berjumpa dengan mana-mana lelaki. Rasya takut ekoran rasa panaroid. Rasya teringat lagi semasa mama tinggalkan dirinya.

programme.title: Tok Samad
programme.desc: Tok Samad, bekas kelasi kapal yang lama menetap di Amerika, kembali ke Malaysia untuk menjaga cucunya, Idris. Perwatakan moden dan bergaya beliau berbeza dengan kehidupan kampung Idris, mencetuskan situasi lucu dan konflik mesra. Ketika itu, Tok Samad juga tertarik pada gadis kampung bernama Siti.

programme.title: Isteri Dalam Sangkar
programme.desc: Pertemuan yang dirancang dengan rapi antara Iskandar dan Tengku Waiduri membuatkan Iskandar semakin tertekan. Di pertemuan itu, Tengku Waiduri secara rahsia memberitahu Iskandar dia sudah mempunyai kekasih da meminta agar Iskandar menggagalkan rancangan Tengku Maria dalam apa jua keadaan, namun hal itu sukar dilakukan oleh Iskandar kerana jawatan CEO sedang menanti dirinya dan ditambah lagi dengan rahsia dia sudah mengahwini Aisyah. Entah kenapa malam itu, Iskandar rasa cukup tertekan, dia tidak tahu apa yang harus difikirkannya. Lalu Iskandar pergi berhibur bersama rakan-rakan dan pulang dalam keadaan mabuk. Aisyah memanjakan dirinya sendiri di kondo mewah itu setelah seharian melakukan kerja. Sebuah tab di ruangan bilik air menjadi pilihan Aisyah untuk memanjakan diri. Tidak sedar Iskandar sudah pulang dan keadaan Iskandar yang mabuk membawa kepada satu kejadian yang merentap mahkota Aisyah. Aisyah langsung tidak menyangka dirinya dirakus sebegitu oleh Iskandar namun dia redha kerana dia adalah seorang isteri, meskipun Aisyah sedar Iskandar tidak menyedari akan kelakuaannya ketika itu tetapi atas tanggungjawab seorang isteri dia harus membiarkan dirinya diperlakukan seperti itu. Aisyah lena di kamar Iskandar, di terkejut apabila Iskandar melemparkan wang di atas tubuhnya.

programme.title: Secebis Rindu
programme.desc: Reeza pandai bermain dengan situasi hingga membuatkan Rasya selesa dengan Reeza. Rasya mula dibuai oleh perasaan atas layanan baik mesra oleh Reeza. Reeza mahu berjumpa dengan Rasya dan jawapan Rasya pantas menjawab TIDAK. Opah beritahu Rasya yang dia nak jodohkan Rasya dengan Fahmi. Rasya terkejut sebab Rasya belum bersedia dan tak pernah cintakan Fahmi.

programme.title: Unhuman
programme.desc: Semasa keluar berkhemah, San dan rakan-rakannya dari sekolah menengah merakam gambar meteor yang terhempas. Gambar itu mengandungi petunjuk kematian seorang saintis yang menjalankan kerja eksperimen dengan organ manusia dan kemungkinan kaitan dengan ahli sihir Kemboja.

programme.title: Larian Terakhir
programme.desc: Haziq, seorang anak tunggal kepada Mariam yang mempunyai bakat dalam larian pantas, sering berhadapan dengan dugaan kehidupan sehinggakan dia terpaksa meninggalkan ibunya yang sakit. Tanpa disedarinya, pertemuannya dengan Jalal telah memerangkapnya dalam sebuah sindiket jenayah. Walaupun Haziq dijanjikan peluang untuk memperbaiki hidupnya, Amelia sentiasa mengawasi setiap pergerakannya dengan teliti. Larian Terakhir adalah sebuah filem yang menggabungkan genre aksi dan sukan dengan penampilan pelakon-pelakon seperti Fattah Amin, Amyra Rosli, dan Fahrin Ahmad, di mana setiap larian akan sampai ke kemuncaknya.

programme.title: J Revolusi
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Jay Zulkarnain Haji Zul Ariffin, ketua Unit Tindakan Khas UTK yang digeruni penjenayah. Konflik tercetus apabila kakaknya, Dian Nur Fazura, ditangkap pengganas misteri, Andra Farid Kamil, yang memiliki Ultra Virus berbahaya. Jay ditugaskan menyekat ancaman virus itu sambil menyelamatkan kakaknya yang dijadikan tebusan. Namun, misi itu membawa tragedi apabila pasukannya terkorban, menimbulkan pelbagai tuduhan dan kejutan. Bersama rakan setugas, Eddie Izara Aishah dan Jiman Iedil Putra, Jay berjuang menentang masa dan musuh untuk menyelamatkan Dian dan menggagalkan rancangan Andra.

programme.title: Bisikan Pontianak
programme.desc: Selepas ditinggalkan suaminya, Suraya membesarkan dua orang anaknya sendirian di sebuah rumah terpencil. Namun apabila bekas suaminya kembali untuk menuntut tanah warisan, kejadian-kejadian aneh mula menghantui kampung mereka, memaksa keluarga itu berdepan dengan rahsia silam yang selama ini tersembunyi.

programme.title: Ganjil
programme.desc: Nabila kehilangan rantai lehernya dalam mimpinya. Apabila Amry mencadangkan mereka mencari rantai di rumah Nabila, dia mendapati kebenaran yang tidak selesa.

programme.title: Once Upon A Time In China II
programme.desc: Tiba dengan kereta api di Guangzhou pada tahun 1895, ketiga-tiga mereka melawan pengikut White Lotus, yang ingin membunuh semua orang asing dan Mak Cik ke-13 yang comel dan berpakaian Eropah. Ia bukanlah pertarungan terakhir pakar kung fu Dr. Wong Jet Li.

programme.title: Parole Examiner Lee EP2
programme.desc: Han-shin menimbulkan kemarahan pihak berkuasa apabila menolak permohonan pembebasan seorang tokoh berpengaruh. Seo-yoon menemui petunjuk yang menghubungkan kesnya dengan seorang banduan yang sedang menunggu parol.

programme.title: Repeaters
programme.desc: Tiga orang remaja berusia dua puluhan mendapati diri mereka berada dalam gelung masa yang mustahil, di mana setiap hari mereka terjaga pada hari yang sama menakutkan seperti hari sebelumnya.

programme.title: Budak Pendamping
programme.desc: Ia mengisahkan tentang seorang budak yang berumur 16 tahun, bernama Firash. Dibesarkan sebagai seorang anak tunggal di sebuah keluarga yang sentiasa sibuk dengan kerjaya, membuatkan Firash lebih senang bersendiriaan. Disebabkan itu keluarganya membuat keputusan untuk hantarnya ke sebuah kem. Disana Firash bertembung dengan Idlan dan rakannya Khai dan Sahar, serta sebahagian dalam Ahli Majlis Tertinggi Asrama AMTA bagi kem tersebut. Akibat ketidakpuasan mereka terhadap Firash yang kelihatan lembik, badannya menjadi tempat untuk mereka lepaskan kekerasan. Namun kehadiran budak pendamping mengubah segalanya untuk Firash tetapi ia juga menggugat kesejahteraan yang dah lama tidak bergelora. Lantas, adakah perjanjian antara Firash dan pendampingnya merupakan ilusi semata - mata ataupun terdapat hutang yang akan dituntut antaranya dengan Tuan Daud?

programme.title: The Equalizer S1
programme.desc: Panggilan dari luar negara untuk mendapatkan bantuan daripada anak perempuan mentor CIA McCall yang telah meninggal dunia memaksa McCall, Mel dan Harry bekerja dari jauh untuk membantu wartawan konflik itu ketika dia dikejar oleh skuad hit di Perancis. Selain itu, Mak Cik Vi menjadi curiga apabila McCall ponteng keluar pada malam keluarga lain untuk bekerja.

programme.title: Siku 12: Langkah Derhaka
programme.desc: Seorang bapa telah merahsiakan ilmu persilatan yang telah lama dipelajari daripada anaknya kerana sejarah hitam yang dilaluinya. Anaknya merupakan peninju Muay Thai dan atas desakan yang bertubi-tubi, bapa akhirnya mewariskan ilmu yang dikenali sebagai Jurus Siku 12 Langkah Derhaka kepada anaknya yang akan bertanding pada pertandingan terbuka Pendang Muay Thai 2021.

programme.title: Tiger Cage II
programme.desc: Selepas berada di tempat yang salah pada masa yang salah seorang bekas polis dan seorang peguam perceraian wanita menjadi buruan dan terpaksa bekerjasama dengan seorang penjenayah untuk membersihkan nama mereka daripada terlibat dalam skim pengubahan wang haram yang dipimpin oleh seorang peguam yang kejam.

programme.title: The Professionals
programme.desc: Dikhianati oleh rakan niaganya, Reza, Abi dipenjarakan. Keluar dari penjara, dia merekrut mangsa Reza, dan merancang untuk membalas dendam.

programme.title: The Lift
programme.desc: Selepas sahabat baiknya hilang, seorang gadis kolej yang menghidap klaustrofobia mula menyiasat lif misteri tempat rakannya kali terakhir dilihat lif yang mungkin merupakan pintu ke dunia gelap yang menakutkan.

programme.title: Kanang Anak Langkau
programme.desc: Sebuah filem berdasarkan kisah benar Sarjan Kanang Anak Langkau, seorang pahlawan iban dan pahlawan perang yang paling terkenal di negara ini, yang berjuang dengan berani semasa pemberontakan komunis.

programme.title: Bunohan
programme.desc: 3 abang pulang ke kampung Bunohan dengan tiga alasan yang sangat berbeza mereka akan menemui kematian, penipuan dan wahyu yang sangat suram.

programme.title: Hysteria! EP2
programme.desc: Populariti band meningkat mendadak, namun perhatian masyarakat mula bertukar menjadi syak wasangka dan ketakutan.

programme.title: Misteri Wan Peah EP9
programme.desc: Mak Timah dan Cikgu Zaiton masih tidak berpuas hati dengan Cikgu Siti yang dikatakan memiliki ilmu hitam. Perkara ini dihebohkan menyebabkan orang kampung mulai menjauhkan diri dari Cikgu Siti. Farhan menegur perbuatan Cikgu Zaiton kerana membuat fitnah kepada Cikgu Siti. Farhan masih cuba berbaik-baik dengan Cikgu Siti, bagaimanapun Cikgu Siti cuba menjauhkan diri dari Farhan kerana telah diberi amaran oleh Mak Timah.

programme.title: Bisikan Pontianak

programme.title: Black S1 EP4
programme.desc: Sebagai tukaran dengan fail ayahnya, Lokman memujuk Sofia untuk bekerja dengannya dan menggunakan kuasa Sofia untuk memberitahunya mana-mana kliennya yang akan menemui ajal. Semasa menjalankan tugas, Sofia bertemu Black yang menyedari kuasa Sofia mungkin kunci untuk membantunya memburu 419. Namun, caranya yang kasar menjengkelkan Sofia dan dia mendapati dirinya tidak diendahkan. Demi memenangi semula hati Sofia, Black menyiasat kes tembakan yang melibatkan Malik untuk meyakinkan Sofia yang dia bukan punca Malik ditembak. Pendirian Sofia berubah menjadi agak lembut dan seterusnya bersetuju untuk membantu Black mendapatkan ingatannya semula. Namun keadaan menjadi rumit apabila Black mengungkai lebih banyak petunjuk tentang kematian Malik dan menyedari nyawanya dalam bahaya.

programme.title: Raya Emas: Salako Sacred Treasure
programme.desc: Jauh di dalam hutan Sarawak, sebuah legenda kuno tentang Raya Emas telah diwarisi turun-temurun. Tapi apabila mata-mata tamak mula mengarah kepadanya, satu perjalanan yang menguji iman dan keberanian bakal terungkai.

programme.title: Misteri Wan Peah EP13
programme.desc: Pada suatu hari, Farhan mengajak 3 sahabatnya bermain sorok-sorok untuk mengingati nostalgia mereka semasa kanak-kanak. Tujuan Farhan sebenarnya adalah untuk mencari Wan Peah. Tiba-tiba, muncul Wan Peah di hadapan Farhan dan bercakap dengannya, Farhan dapat merasakan Wan Peah sebenarnya manusia biasa bukannya hantu. Oleh itu, Farhan berjanji akan membuktikan Wan Peah adalah manusia. Dia menyuarakan rasa cinta kepada Cikgu Siti.

Memaparkan jenayah yang pernah berlaku di Malaysia menurut kronologi kejadian dari siasatan sehingga ke penghakiman.

programme.title: Superhero Hati
programme.desc: Akasyah dan Zahida gembira dengan berita kehamilan Zahida yang memang dinantikan sejak mereka mendirikan rumahtangga. Namun kegembiraan itu bertukar menjadi mimpi ngeri apabila Zahida mengalami alahan yang teruk. Keadaan menjadi bertambah gawat apabila doktor mengumumkan Zahida sedang mengidap kanser payudara tahap keempat. Seluruh impian Akasyah musnah apabila Zahida meninggal dunia ketika melahirkan bayi mereka. Kekecewaan itu membuatkan Akasya melepaskan tanggungjawab menjaga anaknya, Adam Zakhwan, kepada ibunya, Hjh. Fauziah.

programme.title: Deko Ibadah
programme.desc: Team Deko Ibadah kali ini berada di Surau Pak Long Lazim, Semanggol. Deko Ibadah berkongsi inspirasi menghias dan menyusun ruang ibadah yang selesa, praktikal serta menenangkan. Menggabungkan elemen dekorasi dan pengisian Islam, program ini membantu mewujudkan persekitaran yang lebih kondusif untuk beribadah dan menghayati nilai-nilai murni.

programme.title: Sembang Alam Ghaib
programme.desc: Episod kali ini membawakn topik Santau...ada ke?. Program ini mengupas pelbagai kisah seram berkaitan alam ghaib, dengan menampilkan cerita yang diadaptasi daripada pengalaman benar yang pernah dilalui sendiri oleh Dato Ustaz Kazim Elias. Setiap episod turut menyelitkan pengajaran dan panduan dari perspektif Islam mengenai perkara-perkara ghaib.

programme.title: Tanam Apa Tuu?

programme.title: Sunnah Nabi

programme.title: Rindu Yang Hilang
programme.desc: Hamidah telah 5 hari menghilangkan diri, semua orang mencari Hamidah. Sama ada pergi bercuti atau lari daripada masalah masih pencari persoalan kehilangan Hamidah.
